    """

    id = models.UUIDField(

    )  # Changed to UUID PK
    trip = models.ForeignKey(
        Trip,
        verbose_name=_("Trip"),
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="properties",
        db_column="trip_id",  # Map to existing column name
    )
    name = models.CharField(_("Name"), max_length=255)
    address = models.TextField(_("Address"))
    property_url = models.URLField(_("Property URL"), blank=True)
    description = models.TextField(_("Description"), blank=True)
    listing_source = models.CharField(_("Listing Source"), max_length=100, blank=True)
    listing_title = models.CharField(_("Listing Title"), max_length=255, blank=True)
    listing_image_url = models.URLField(_("Listing Image URL"), blank=True)
    listing_last_refreshed_at = models.DateTimeField(
        _("Listing Last Refreshed At"),
        null=True,
        blank=True,
    )
    is_primary = models.BooleanField(_("Is Primary"), default=False)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(_("Created At"), auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(_("Updated At"), auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "trips_tripproperty"
        verbose_name = _("Trip Property")
        verbose_name_plural = _("Trip Properties")
        ordering = ["-is_primary", "name"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.name} - {self.trip.name}"

    def save(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        previous_url = ""
        if self.pk:
            previous_url = (
                TripProperty.objects.filter(pk=self.pk)
                .values_list("property_url", flat=True)
                .first()
                or ""
            )

        if not self.property_url:
            self.listing_source = ""
            self.listing_title = ""
            self.listing_image_url = ""
            self.listing_last_refreshed_at = None

        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

        if self.property_url and self.property_url != previous_url:
            from trips.tasks import refresh_trip_property_listing_preview_task

            property_id = str(self.pk)
            transaction.on_commit(
                lambda: refresh_trip_property_listing_preview_task.delay(property_id)
            )

    def get_property_type(self) -> str:
        """Determine the property type based on the URL."""
        if not self.property_url:
            return "other"

        url_lower = self.property_url.lower()
        if "airbnb.com" in url_lower:
            return "airbnb"
        elif "vrbo.com" in url_lower:
            return "vrbo"
        else:
            return "other"

    def get_external_links(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Return a dictionary of external links."""
        if not self.property_url:
            return {}

        property_type = self.get_property_type()
        return {property_type: self.property_url}

class BaseList(models.Model):
    """
    Abstract base model for lists.

    This is an abstract base class for packing and grocery lists.
    """

    trip = models.ForeignKey(
        Trip, verbose_name=_("Trip"), on_delete=models.CASCADE, db_column="trip_id"
    )
    name = models.CharField(_("Name"), max_length=255)
    description = models.TextField(
        _("Description"), blank=True, null=True
    )  # Allow NULL in DB
    is_group = models.BooleanField(_("Is Group List"), default=True)
    owner = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, verbose_name=_("Owner"), on_delete=models.CASCADE
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(_("Created At"), auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(_("Updated At"), auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        abstract = True
        ordering = ["name"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.name} - {self.trip.name}"

    # Optional: Link back to the template it was created from
    # Note: source_template field moved to concrete classes below

    def completion_percentage(self) -> float:
        """Calculate the completion percentage of the list."""
        # Ensure self.items exists and is iterable
        items_manager = getattr(self, "items", None)
        if items_manager is None:
            return 0
        total_items = int(items_manager.count())
        if total_items == 0:
            return 0
        completed_items = int(items_manager.filter(is_completed=True).count())
        return (completed_items / total_items) * 100

"""Detection and repair of ingest damage on RegionEvent rows.

Backs the ``repair_region_event_ingest`` management command and the
read-only sections of ``audit_region_event_ingest``. Each detector returns
:class:`RepairFinding` records describing the issue and the proposed
change; ``apply`` performs the change.

Issue classes (from REGION_INGEST_AUDIT_2026-06.md):
- ``unbounded_recurrence``: DAILY/WEEKLY scraped events with no
  recurrence_end_date render until Dec 31 (zombie cards).
- ``overspanned_food``: non-recurring FOOD events spanning many days show a
  stale menu on every spanned day.
- ``weekday_mismatch``: WEEKLY rows whose recurrence_days disagree with the
  weekday named in the title / the start date (Sunday=0 payloads).
- ``duplicate_venue_day``: two active events from the same source rendering
  for the same venue on the same day.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Callable

from django.utils import timezone

from trips.services.dedup_service import (
    SAME_SOURCE_NAME_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD,
    names_match,
    normalize_name,
)
from trips.services.recurrence_alignment import (
    align_weekly_recurrence,
    weekday_from_title,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from trips.models import RegionEvent

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

#: How far past the last confirmation a scraped recurrence may keep rendering.
SCRAPED_RECURRENCE_HORIZON_DAYS = 14

#: Maximum plausible span for a non-recurring FOOD special.
MAX_FOOD_SPAN_DAYS = 7

#: How far ahead to expand occurrences when looking for venue-day duplicates.
DUPLICATE_HORIZON_DAYS = 14


@dataclass
class RepairFinding:
    event: RegionEvent
    issue_class: str
    description: str
    apply: Callable[[], None]


def _active_source_events(source_key: str):
    from trips.models import RegionEvent

    return RegionEvent.objects.filter(
        event_source__source_key=source_key,
        is_active=True,
    ).select_related("event_source")


def find_unbounded_scraped_recurrences(source_key: str) -> list[RepairFinding]:
    """DAILY/WEEKLY scraped events with no recurrence end date."""
    findings: list[RepairFinding] = []
    events = _active_source_events(source_key).filter(
        recurrence_pattern__in=["DAILY", "WEEKLY"],
        recurrence_end_date__isnull=True,
        event_source__source_type="SCRAPER",
    )
    for event in events:
        anchor = (
            timezone.localtime(event.last_ingested_at).date()
            if event.last_ingested_at
            else timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime).date()
        )
        proposed_end = anchor + timedelta(days=SCRAPED_RECURRENCE_HORIZON_DAYS)

        def apply(event: RegionEvent = event, proposed_end: date = proposed_end) -> None:
            event.recurrence_end_date = proposed_end
            event.save(update_fields=["recurrence_end_date"])

        findings.append(
            RepairFinding(
                event=event,
                issue_class="unbounded_recurrence",
                description=(
                    f"{event.recurrence_pattern} with no end date; "
                    f"set recurrence_end_date={proposed_end.isoformat()}"
                ),
                apply=apply,
            )
        )
    return findings


def find_overspanned_food(
    source_key: str, *, max_days: int = MAX_FOOD_SPAN_DAYS
) -> list[RepairFinding]:
    """Non-recurring FOOD events spanning more than ``max_days`` days."""
    findings: list[RepairFinding] = []
    events = _active_source_events(source_key).filter(
        category="FOOD",
        recurrence_pattern="NONE",
    )
    for event in events:
        local_start = timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime)
        local_end = timezone.localtime(event.end_datetime)
        span_days = (local_end.date() - local_start.date()).days
        if span_days <= max_days:
            continue
        proposed_end = local_start.replace(
            hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0
        )

        def apply(event: RegionEvent = event, proposed_end=proposed_end) -> None:
            event.end_datetime = proposed_end
            event.save(update_fields=["end_datetime"])

        findings.append(
            RepairFinding(
                event=event,
                issue_class="overspanned_food",
                description=(
                    f"NONE FOOD event spans {span_days} days "
                    f"({local_start.date()} -> {local_end.date()}); "
                    f"truncate end to {proposed_end.date().isoformat()}"
                ),
                apply=apply,
            )
        )
    return findings


def find_weekday_mismatched_weekly(source_key: str) -> list[RepairFinding]:
    """WEEKLY single-day rows whose day index contradicts title/start date."""
    findings: list[RepairFinding] = []
    events = _active_source_events(source_key).filter(recurrence_pattern="WEEKLY")
    for event in events:
        days = [
            int(token)
            for token in str(event.recurrence_days or "").split(",")
            if token.strip().lstrip("-").isdigit()
        ]
        if len(days) != 1:
            continue
        local_start_date = timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime).date()
        title_day = weekday_from_title(event.name)
        if days[0] == local_start_date.weekday():
            continue
        if title_day is not None and days[0] == title_day:
            continue

        alignment = align_weekly_recurrence(
            title=event.name,
            description=event.description,
            start_date=local_start_date,
            recurrence_days=event.recurrence_days,
        )
        if alignment.days == event.recurrence_days:
            continue

        def apply(event: RegionEvent = event, alignment=alignment) -> None:
            event.recurrence_days = alignment.days
            update_fields = ["recurrence_days"]
            local_start = timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime)
            if alignment.start_date != local_start.date():
                delta = alignment.start_date - local_start.date()
                event.start_datetime = event.start_datetime + delta
                event.end_datetime = event.end_datetime + delta
                update_fields += ["start_datetime", "end_datetime"]
            event.save(update_fields=update_fields)

        findings.append(
            RepairFinding(
                event=event,
                issue_class="weekday_mismatch",
                description=(
                    f"WEEKLY days={event.recurrence_days!r} contradicts "
                    f"start weekday {local_start_date.weekday()} "
                    f"and title; realign to days={alignment.days!r}"
                ),
                apply=apply,
            )
        )
    return findings


def find_duplicate_venue_day(
    source_key: str, *, horizon_days: int = DUPLICATE_HORIZON_DAYS
) -> list[RepairFinding]:
    """Pairs of same-source events rendering for the same venue on a day.

    Keeps the older row (lower pk) and proposes deactivating the newer one.
    """
    from trips.models import RegionEvent

    today = timezone.localdate()
    horizon_end = today + timedelta(days=horizon_days)

    events = list(

from typing import Any

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from trips.models import RegionEvent
from trips.services.region_event_place_enrichment import _looks_like_address


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Report ingest quality issues for an EventSource source_key"

    def add_arguments(self, parser: Any) -> None:
        parser.add_argument(
            "--source-key",
            required=True,
            help="EventSource source_key to audit",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--limit",
            type=int,
            default=5,
            help="Maximum example rows to print per category",
        )

    def handle(self, *args: Any, **options: Any) -> Any:
        source_key = str(options["source_key"])
        limit = int(options["limit"])
        queryset = (
            RegionEvent.objects.filter(
                event_source__source_key=source_key,
                is_active=True,
            )
            .select_related(
                "event_source", "region_calendar__region", "matched_business"
            )
            .order_by("start_datetime", "id")
        )
        if not queryset.exists():
            raise CommandError(
                f"No active RegionEvent rows found for source_key '{source_key}'."
            )

        food_events = list(queryset.filter(category="FOOD"))
        multi_day_non_recurring = [
            event
            for event in food_events
            if event.recurrence_pattern == "NONE"
            and event.end_datetime.date() > event.start_datetime.date()
        ]
        no_match_events = list(queryset.filter(location_enrichment_status="NO_MATCH"))
        blank_address_events = list(queryset.filter(address=""))
        weak_address_events = [
            event
            for event in queryset.exclude(address="")
            if not _looks_like_address(event.address)
        ]
        missing_latlng_events = list(
            queryset.filter(Q(latitude__isnull=True) | Q(longitude__isnull=True))
        )
        matched_events = list(queryset.filter(location_enrichment_status="MATCHED"))

        self.stdout.write(f"Audit for source_key={source_key}")
        self.stdout.write(f"active_total={queryset.count()}")
        self.stdout.write(f"active_food={len(food_events)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"matched={len(matched_events)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"no_match={len(no_match_events)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"blank_address={len(blank_address_events)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"weak_address={len(weak_address_events)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"missing_latlng={len(missing_latlng_events)}")
        self.stdout.write(
            f"multi_day_non_recurring_food={len(multi_day_non_recurring)}"
        )

        self._write_examples(
            label="Multi-day non-recurring FOOD",
            events=multi_day_non_recurring,
            limit=limit,
        )
        self._write_examples(
            label="NO_MATCH",
            events=no_match_events,
            limit=limit,
        )
        self._write_examples(
            label="Blank address",
            events=blank_address_events,
            limit=limit,
        )
        self._write_examples(
            label="Weak address",
            events=weak_address_events,
            limit=limit,
        )
        self._write_examples(
            label="Missing lat/lng",
            events=missing_latlng_events,
            limit=limit,
        )

    def _write_examples(
        self,
        *,
        label: str,
        events: list[RegionEvent],
        limit: int,
    ) -> None:
        self.stdout.write("")
        self.stdout.write(f"{label}: {len(events)}")
        for event in events[:limit]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "  "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"id={event.id}",
                        f"slug={event.slug or '-'}",
                        f"dates={event.start_datetime.date()}->{event.end_datetime.date()}",
                        f"recurrence={event.recurrence_pattern}",
                        f"location={event.location or '-'}",
                        f"address={event.address or '-'}",
                        f"status={event.location_enrichment_status}",
                        f"external_id={event.external_id or '-'}",
                    ]
                )
            )

"""Tests for region-event ingest repair detection and the repair command."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta
from io import StringIO
from typing import Any

import pytest
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.management import call_command
from django.utils import timezone

from trips.models import EventSource, RegionCalendar, RegionEvent, TripRegion
from trips.services.region_event_repair import (
    find_duplicate_venue_day,
    find_overspanned_food,
    find_unbounded_scraped_recurrences,
    find_weekday_mismatched_weekly,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.django_db

SOURCE_KEY = "outer-banks-specials"


@pytest.fixture()
def region_calendar(db: Any) -> Any:
    region = TripRegion.objects.create(name="Outer Banks", is_active=True)
    return RegionCalendar.objects.create(region=region)


@pytest.fixture()
def scraper_source(region_calendar: Any) -> Any:
    return EventSource.objects.create(
        region_calendar=region_calendar,
        name="Outer Banks Specials",
        source_type="SCRAPER",
        source_key=SOURCE_KEY,
    )


@pytest.fixture()
def system_user(db: Any) -> Any:
    return User.objects.create_user(  # pragma: allowlist secret
        username="system", password="testpass123"
    )


def _event(
    region_calendar: Any,
    system_user: Any,
    source: Any,
    name: str,
    start_date: date,
    *,
    end_date: date | None = None,
    external_id: str = "",
    **extra: Any,
) -> RegionEvent:
    start_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(start_date, time.min))
    end_dt = timezone.make_aware(
        datetime.combine(end_date or start_date, time(23, 59, 59))
    )
    return RegionEvent.objects.create(
        region_calendar=region_calendar,
        event_source=source,
        name=name,
        start_datetime=start_dt,
        end_datetime=end_dt,
        external_id=external_id or f"test:{name.lower().replace(' ', '-')}",
        created_by=system_user,
        category="FOOD",
        **extra,
    )


class TestUnboundedScrapedRecurrences:
    def test_detects_and_caps_unbounded_daily(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        zombie = _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Jolly Roger Restaurant Happy Hour",
            date(2026, 4, 1),
            recurrence_pattern="DAILY",
        )

        findings = find_unbounded_scraped_recurrences(SOURCE_KEY)

        assert len(findings) == 1
        assert findings[0].event.pk == zombie.pk
        findings[0].apply()
        zombie.refresh_from_db()
        assert zombie.recurrence_end_date == date(2026, 4, 15)

    def test_uses_last_ingested_at_when_set(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        event = _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Snow Birds Lunch Specials",
            date(2026, 4, 1),
            recurrence_pattern="DAILY",
            last_ingested_at=timezone.make_aware(
                datetime.combine(date(2026, 6, 1), time(12, 0))
            ),
        )

        findings = find_unbounded_scraped_recurrences(SOURCE_KEY)

        findings[0].apply()
        event.refresh_from_db()
        assert event.recurrence_end_date == date(2026, 6, 15)

    def test_bounded_recurrence_not_flagged(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Bounded Happy Hour",
            date(2026, 4, 1),
            recurrence_pattern="DAILY",
            recurrence_end_date=date(2026, 4, 30),
        )

        assert find_unbounded_scraped_recurrences(SOURCE_KEY) == []


class TestOverspannedFood:
    def test_truncates_overspanned_food(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        sprawler = _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Henry's Restaurant-OBX Specials",
            date(2026, 5, 1),
            end_date=date(2026, 5, 20),
        )

        findings = find_overspanned_food(SOURCE_KEY)

        assert len(findings) == 1
        findings[0].apply()
        sprawler.refresh_from_db()
        local_start = timezone.localtime(sprawler.start_datetime)
        local_end = timezone.localtime(sprawler.end_datetime)
        assert local_start.date() == local_end.date()

    def test_short_span_not_flagged(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Weekend Specials",
            date(2026, 5, 1),
            end_date=date(2026, 5, 3),
        )

        assert find_overspanned_food(SOURCE_KEY) == []


class TestWeekdayMismatchedWeekly:
    def test_repairs_sunday_convention_weekly_rows(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        # Sunday=0 payload: "1" intended Monday; start date is a Monday.
        event = _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Mussels Monday",
            date(2026, 6, 8),  # a Monday
            recurrence_pattern="WEEKLY",
            recurrence_days="1",
        )

        findings = find_weekday_mismatched_weekly(SOURCE_KEY)

        assert len(findings) == 1
        findings[0].apply()
        event.refresh_from_db()
        assert event.recurrence_days == "0"
        assert timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime).date() == date(2026, 6, 8)

    def test_consistent_weekly_not_flagged(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Taco Tuesday",
            date(2026, 6, 9),  # a Tuesday
            recurrence_pattern="WEEKLY",
            recurrence_days="1",
        )

        assert find_weekday_mismatched_weekly(SOURCE_KEY) == []


class TestDuplicateVenueDay:
    def test_deactivates_duplicate_venue_day_keeping_oldest(
        self, region_calendar: Any, system_user: Any, scraper_source: Any
    ) -> None:
        today = timezone.localdate()
        older = _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Henry's Restaurant Specials",
            today,
            recurrence_pattern="DAILY",
            recurrence_end_date=today + timedelta(days=10),
            location="Henry's Restaurant, Kitty Hawk, NC",
        )
        newer = _event(
            region_calendar,
            system_user,
            scraper_source,
            "Henry's Restaurant-OBX Specials",
            today,
            recurrence_pattern="DAILY",
            recurrence_end_date=today + timedelta(days=10),
            location="Henry's Restaurant, Kitty Hawk, NC",
            external_id="test:henrys-2",
        )

        findings = find_duplicate_venue_day(SOURCE_KEY)

        assert len(findings) == 1
        assert findings[0].event.pk == newer.pk
        findings[0].apply()
        older.refresh_from_db()
        newer.refresh_from_db()
        assert older.is_active is True

def _decode_flyer_bytes(content_base64: str) -> bytes:
    normalized = str(content_base64 or "").strip()
    if normalized.startswith("data:") and "," in normalized:
        normalized = normalized.split(",", 1)[1]
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError("Flyer image content is required")
    try:
        return base64.b64decode(normalized, validate=True)
    except binascii.Error as exc:
        raise ValueError("Flyer image payload is not valid base64") from exc


def _normalize_flyer_content_type(*, content_type: str, original_filename: str) -> str:
    normalized = str(content_type or "").strip().lower()
    if not normalized:
        guessed, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(original_filename or "")
        normalized = str(guessed or "").lower()
    if not normalized:
        normalized = "image/png"
    if normalized not in settings.ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported flyer image type: {normalized}")
    return normalized


def _flyer_extension(*, content_type: str, original_filename: str) -> str:
    extension = str(original_filename or "").strip()
    extension = extension.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in extension else ""
    if extension:
        return f".{extension}"
    guessed = mimetypes.guess_extension(content_type) or ".png"
    return ".jpg" if guessed == ".jpe" else guessed


def _store_flyer_image(
    *,
    event: RegionEvent,
    flyer_image: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    content_bytes = _decode_flyer_bytes(str(flyer_image.get("content_base64") or ""))
    if len(content_bytes) > settings.MAX_IMAGE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("Flyer image exceeds the maximum allowed size")

    original_filename = str(flyer_image.get("original_filename") or "")
    content_type = _normalize_flyer_content_type(
        content_type=str(flyer_image.get("content_type") or ""),
        original_filename=original_filename,
    )
    extension = _flyer_extension(
        content_type=content_type,
        original_filename=original_filename,
    )
    source_key = (
        str(getattr(getattr(event, "event_source", None), "source_key", "") or "region")
        .strip()
        .replace("/", "-")
    )
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content_bytes).hexdigest()
    file_key = f"region-events/flyers/{source_key}/{event.id}/{digest}{extension}"
    storage = storages["s3uploadEvents"]
    if not storage.exists(file_key):
        storage.save(file_key, ContentFile(content_bytes))
    return file_key, content_type


def _event_flyer_route(event: RegionEvent) -> str:
    return reverse("regions:event_flyer", kwargs={"event_id": event.id})

    *,

def _attachment_group_key(external_id: str) -> str | None:
    parts = [part for part in str(external_id or "").split(":") if part]
    if len(parts) < 3:
        return None
    return ":".join(parts[:3])


def _deactivate_missing_attachment_events(
    *,
    event_source: EventSource,
    incoming_external_ids: set[str],
) -> int:
    if not incoming_external_ids:
        return 0

    group_keys = {
        key
        for external_id in incoming_external_ids
        if (key := _attachment_group_key(external_id))
    }
    if not group_keys:
        return 0

    stale_event_ids: list[int] = []
    for event in RegionEvent.objects.filter(
        event_source=event_source,
        category="FOOD",
        is_active=True,
    ).exclude(external_id=""):
        group_key = _attachment_group_key(event.external_id)
        if group_key in group_keys and event.external_id not in incoming_external_ids:
            stale_event_ids.append(event.id)

    if not stale_event_ids:
        return 0

    return RegionEvent.objects.filter(id__in=stale_event_ids).update(is_active=False)


def _validate_recurrence_window(
    *,
    start_date: date,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    recurrence_end_date: date | None,
) -> None:
    if recurrence_pattern == "NONE":
        return

    if recurrence_end_date is None:
        return

    if recurrence_end_date < start_date:
        raise ValueError("recurrence_end_date cannot be earlier than start_date")


_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:breakfast|brunch|lunch|dinner|all[- ]?day)\b", re.IGNORECASE
)


def _apply_existing_event_update(
    event: RegionEvent, defaults: dict[str, Any]
) -> RegionEvent:
    defaults = dict(defaults)
    new_start = defaults.get("start_datetime")
    if (
        event.recurrence_pattern == "NONE"
        and new_start is not None
        and timezone.localtime(new_start).date()
        != timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime).date()
    ):
        # A non-recurring event must never migrate to a different day via a
        # repost match — that is how per-day items collapsed into one row.
        logger.warning(
            "Refusing to move non-recurring region event %s from %s to %s",
            event.pk,
            event.start_datetime.date(),
            new_start.date(),
        )
        defaults.pop("start_datetime", None)
        defaults.pop("end_datetime", None)
    for field, value in defaults.items():
        setattr(event, field, value)
    event.save()
    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
    return event


def _apply_meal_period_merge(
    event: RegionEvent, defaults: dict[str, Any]
) -> RegionEvent:
    """Merge a new meal-period event into an existing one from the same venue."""
    new_desc = str(defaults.get("description", "") or "")
    if new_desc:
        existing_lines = set(event.description.strip().splitlines())
        extra_lines = [
            line
            for line in new_desc.strip().splitlines()
            if line.strip() and line.strip() not in existing_lines
        ]
        if extra_lines:
            combined = event.description.rstrip()
            if combined:
                combined += "\n"
            combined += "\n".join(extra_lines)
            event.description = combined

    event.meal_period = None

    new_start = defaults.get("start_datetime", event.start_datetime)
    new_end = defaults.get("end_datetime", event.end_datetime)
    event.start_datetime = min(event.start_datetime, new_start)
    # Meal merges only combine same-day cards; the end must stay on the
    # start day or repeated reposts grow the event into a permanent card.
    local_start = timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime)
    end_of_day = local_start.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0)
    event.end_datetime = min(max(event.end_datetime, new_end), end_of_day)

    existing_name = str(event.name or "")
    new_name = str(defaults.get("name", "") or "")
    existing_has_meal = bool(_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.search(existing_name))
    new_has_meal = bool(_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.search(new_name))
    if existing_has_meal and not new_has_meal:
        event.name = new_name
    elif not existing_has_meal and new_has_meal:
        pass  # keep existing (no meal keyword)
    elif existing_has_meal and new_has_meal:
        # Both have meal keywords — strip the meal keyword from existing
        stripped = _MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.sub("", existing_name).strip()
        stripped = re.sub(r"\s{2,}", " ", stripped)
        if stripped:
            event.name = stripped

    for field in ("image_url", "external_url", "address"):
        existing_val = getattr(event, field, "")
        new_val = defaults.get(field, "")
        if not existing_val and new_val:
            setattr(event, field, new_val)

    event.save()
    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
    return event


class EventIngestView(APIView):
    """POST /api/region-events/ingest/

    Receives a batch of scraped events and upserts them as RegionEvent records.
    """

    authentication_classes = [SharedSecretAuthentication]
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:

        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)

        source_key: str = data["source_key"]
        replace_existing_attachment_events = bool(
            data.get("replace_existing_attachment_events")
        )
        try:
            event_source = EventSource.objects.get(source_key=source_key)
        except EventSource.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"detail": f"Unknown source_key: {source_key}"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,

            return Response(
                {"detail": f"Event source '{source_key}' is disabled."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        system_user = get_system_calendar_user()
        created = 0
        updated = 0
        skipped = 0
        errors = 0

        if replace_existing_attachment_events:
            incoming_food_external_ids = {
                str(event_data["external_id"])
                for event_data in data["events"]
                if (event_data.get("category") or event_source.default_category)
                == "FOOD"
            }
            deactivated = _deactivate_missing_attachment_events(
                event_source=event_source,
                incoming_external_ids=incoming_food_external_ids,
            )
            if deactivated:
                logger.info(
                    "Deactivated %s stale attachment event(s) for source '%s'",
                    deactivated,
                    source_key,
                )

        for event_data in data["events"]:
            try:
                start_date = event_data["start_date"]
                end_date = event_data.get("end_date") or start_date
                recurrence_pattern = event_data.get("recurrence_pattern") or "NONE"
                recurrence_days = event_data.get("recurrence_days") or ""
                recurrence_end_date = event_data.get("recurrence_end_date")
                description = sanitize_event_description(
                    event_data.get("description", "")
                )
                if recurrence_pattern == "WEEKLY":
                    alignment = align_weekly_recurrence(
                        title=event_data.get("title", ""),
                        description=event_data.get("description", ""),
                        start_date=start_date,
                        recurrence_days=recurrence_days,
                    )
                    recurrence_days = alignment.days
                    if alignment.start_date != start_date:
                        end_date = end_date + (alignment.start_date - start_date)
                        start_date = alignment.start_date
                    if alignment.warnings:
                        logger.warning(
                            "Weekly recurrence aligned for '%s' (%s): %s",
                            event_data.get("title", "?"),
                            event_data.get("external_id", "?"),
                            ",".join(alignment.warnings),
                        )

                _validate_recurrence_window(
                    start_date=start_date,
                    recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                    recurrence_end_date=recurrence_end_date,
                )

                start_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(start_date, time.min))
                end_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                    datetime.combine(end_date, time(23, 59, 59))
                )

                # Cross-source dedup: only check for new events.
                already_exists = RegionEvent.objects.filter(
                    event_source=event_source,
                    external_id=event_data["external_id"],
                ).exists()
                if not already_exists:
                    title = event_data["title"]
                    cross_dup = RegionEventDedupService.find_cross_source_duplicate(
                        event_source.region_calendar,
                        title,
                        start_dt,
                        exclude_event_source_id=event_source.id,
                    )
                    if cross_dup:
                        logger.info(
                            "Skipping scraped event '%s' — cross-source duplicate "
                            "of '%s'",
                            title,
                            cross_dup.name,
                        )
                        skipped += 1
                        continue

                defaults = {
                    "name": event_data["title"],
                    "description": description,
                    "start_datetime": start_dt,
                    "end_datetime": end_dt,
                    "location": event_data.get("location", ""),
                    "meal_period": event_data.get("meal_period") or None,
                    "external_url": event_data.get("external_url", ""),
                    "image_url": event_data.get("image_url", ""),
                    "category": event_data.get("category")
                    or event_source.default_category,
                    "recurrence_pattern": recurrence_pattern,
                    "recurrence_days": recurrence_days,
                    "recurrence_end_date": recurrence_end_date,
                    "region_calendar": event_source.region_calendar,
                    "created_by": system_user,
                    "is_active": True,
                }
                if "address" in event_data:
                    defaults["address"] = event_data.get("address", "")
                if "source_confidence" in event_data:
                    defaults["source_confidence"] = event_data.get("source_confidence")
                flyer_image = event_data.get("flyer_image")
                incoming_image_url = str(event_data.get("image_url", "") or "")

                if not already_exists:
                    same_source_dup = (
                        RegionEventDedupService.find_same_source_near_duplicate(
                            event_source,
                            name=event_data["title"],
                            start_datetime=start_dt,
                            location=event_data.get("location", ""),
                            description=description,
                            meal_period=event_data.get("meal_period") or None,
                            recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                            recurrence_days=recurrence_days,
                            category=event_data.get("category")
                            or event_source.default_category,
                        )
                    )
                    if same_source_dup:
                        logger.info(
                            "Updating same-source near-duplicate '%s' using existing event %s",
                            event_data["title"],
                            same_source_dup.pk,
                        )

                            event = _apply_existing_event_update(
                                same_source_dup, defaults
                            )
                            _sync_uploaded_flyer(
                                event=event,
                                flyer_image=flyer_image,
                                incoming_image_url=incoming_image_url,
                            )
                        updated += 1
                        continue

                if not already_exists:
                    meal_merge = (
                        RegionEventDedupService.find_same_venue_meal_merge_candidate(
                            event_source,
                            name=event_data["title"],
                            start_datetime=start_dt,
                            location=event_data.get("location", ""),
                            category=event_data.get("category")
                            or event_source.default_category,
                            meal_period=event_data.get("meal_period") or None,
                        )
                    )
                    if meal_merge:
                        logger.info(
                            "Merging meal-period event '%s' into existing event %s",
                            event_data["title"],
                            meal_merge.pk,
                        )
                        with transaction.atomic():
                            event = _apply_meal_period_merge(meal_merge, defaults)
                            _sync_uploaded_flyer(
                                event=event,
                                flyer_image=flyer_image,
                                incoming_image_url=incoming_image_url,
                            )
                        updated += 1
                        continue

                with transaction.atomic():
                    event, was_created = RegionEvent.objects.update_or_create(
                        event_source=event_source,
                        external_id=event_data["external_id"],
                        defaults=defaults,
                    )
                    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
                    _sync_uploaded_flyer(
                        event=event,
                        flyer_image=flyer_image,
                        incoming_image_url=incoming_image_url,
                    )

                if was_created:
                    created += 1
                else:
                    updated += 1

            except IntegrityError:
                # Concurrent insert race — row now exists, count as update
                updated += 1
            except Exception:
                logger.exception(
                    "Error ingesting event '%s' for source '%s'",
                    event_data.get("title", "?"),
                    source_key,
                )
                errors += 1

        response_status = (
            status.HTTP_207_MULTI_STATUS if errors > 0 else status.HTTP_200_OK
        )
        return Response(
            {
                "created": created,
                "updated": updated,
                "skipped": skipped,
                "errors": errors,
            },
            status=response_status,
        )

    )
    extension = _flyer_extension(
        content_type=content_type,
        original_filename=original_filename,
    )
    source_key = (
        str(getattr(getattr(event, "event_source", None), "source_key", "") or "region")
        .strip()
        .replace("/", "-")
    )
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content_bytes).hexdigest()
    file_key = f"region-events/flyers/{source_key}/{event.id}/{digest}{extension}"
    storage = storages["s3uploadEvents"]
    if not storage.exists(file_key):
        storage.save(file_key, ContentFile(content_bytes))
    return file_key, content_type


def _event_flyer_route(event: RegionEvent) -> str:
    return reverse("regions:event_flyer", kwargs={"event_id": event.id})


def _sync_uploaded_flyer(
    *,
    event: RegionEvent,
    flyer_image: dict[str, Any] | None,
    incoming_image_url: str,
) -> None:
    if flyer_image:
        try:
            file_key, content_type = _store_flyer_image(
                event=event,
                flyer_image=flyer_image,
            )
        except ValueError:
            logger.warning(
                "Skipping invalid flyer upload for region event %s",
                event.pk,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            return

        storage = storages["s3uploadEvents"]
        previous_file_key = str(getattr(event, "flyer_file_key", "") or "")
        route = _event_flyer_route(event)
        update_fields: list[str] = []

        if previous_file_key and previous_file_key != file_key:
            storage.delete(previous_file_key)
        if event.flyer_file_key != file_key:
            event.flyer_file_key = file_key
            update_fields.append("flyer_file_key")
        if event.flyer_content_type != content_type:
            event.flyer_content_type = content_type
            update_fields.append("flyer_content_type")
        if event.image_url != route:
            event.image_url = route
            update_fields.append("image_url")
        if update_fields:
            event.save(update_fields=update_fields)
        return

    if event.flyer_file_key and not incoming_image_url:
        route = _event_flyer_route(event)
        if event.image_url != route:
            event.image_url = route
            event.save(update_fields=["image_url"])


def _attachment_group_key(external_id: str) -> str | None:
    parts = [part for part in str(external_id or "").split(":") if part]
    if len(parts) < 3:
        return None
    return ":".join(parts[:3])


def _deactivate_missing_attachment_events(
    *,
    event_source: EventSource,
    incoming_external_ids: set[str],
) -> int:
    if not incoming_external_ids:
        return 0

    group_keys = {
        key
        for external_id in incoming_external_ids
        if (key := _attachment_group_key(external_id))
    }
    if not group_keys:
        return 0

    stale_event_ids: list[int] = []
    for event in RegionEvent.objects.filter(
        event_source=event_source,
        category="FOOD",
        is_active=True,
    ).exclude(external_id=""):
        group_key = _attachment_group_key(event.external_id)
        if group_key in group_keys and event.external_id not in incoming_external_ids:
            stale_event_ids.append(event.id)

    if not stale_event_ids:
        return 0

    return RegionEvent.objects.filter(id__in=stale_event_ids).update(is_active=False)


#: Scraped DAILY/WEEKLY events without an explicit end date only render for
#: this many days past their start; reposts refresh the window.
SCRAPED_RECURRENCE_HORIZON_DAYS = 14


def _default_scraper_recurrence_horizon(
    *,
    event_source: EventSource,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    start_date: date,
    recurrence_end_date: date | None,
) -> date | None:
    if recurrence_end_date is not None:
        return recurrence_end_date
    if event_source.source_type != "SCRAPER":
        return None
    if recurrence_pattern not in ("DAILY", "WEEKLY"):
        return None
    return start_date + timedelta(days=SCRAPED_RECURRENCE_HORIZON_DAYS)


def _validate_recurrence_window(
    *,
    start_date: date,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    recurrence_end_date: date | None,
) -> None:
    if recurrence_pattern == "NONE":
        return

    if recurrence_end_date is None:
        return

    if recurrence_end_date < start_date:
        raise ValueError("recurrence_end_date cannot be earlier than start_date")


_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:breakfast|brunch|lunch|dinner|all[- ]?day)\b", re.IGNORECASE
)


def _apply_existing_event_update(
    event: RegionEvent, defaults: dict[str, Any]
) -> RegionEvent:
    defaults = dict(defaults)
    new_start = defaults.get("start_datetime")
    if (
        event.recurrence_pattern == "NONE"
        and new_start is not None
        and timezone.localtime(new_start).date()
        != timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime).date()
    ):
        # A non-recurring event must never migrate to a different day via a
        # repost match — that is how per-day items collapsed into one row.
        logger.warning(
            "Refusing to move non-recurring region event %s from %s to %s",
            event.pk,
            event.start_datetime.date(),
            new_start.date(),
        )
        defaults.pop("start_datetime", None)
        defaults.pop("end_datetime", None)
    for field, value in defaults.items():
        setattr(event, field, value)
    event.save()
    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
    return event


def _apply_meal_period_merge(
    event: RegionEvent, defaults: dict[str, Any]
) -> RegionEvent:
    """Merge a new meal-period event into an existing one from the same venue."""
    new_desc = str(defaults.get("description", "") or "")
    if new_desc:
        existing_lines = set(event.description.strip().splitlines())
        extra_lines = [
            line
            for line in new_desc.strip().splitlines()
            if line.strip() and line.strip() not in existing_lines
        ]
        if extra_lines:
            combined = event.description.rstrip()
            if combined:
                combined += "\n"
            combined += "\n".join(extra_lines)
            event.description = combined

    event.meal_period = None

    new_start = defaults.get("start_datetime", event.start_datetime)
    new_end = defaults.get("end_datetime", event.end_datetime)
    event.start_datetime = min(event.start_datetime, new_start)
    # Meal merges only combine same-day cards; the end must stay on the
    # start day or repeated reposts grow the event into a permanent card.
    local_start = timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime)
    end_of_day = local_start.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0)
    event.end_datetime = min(max(event.end_datetime, new_end), end_of_day)

    existing_name = str(event.name or "")
    new_name = str(defaults.get("name", "") or "")
    existing_has_meal = bool(_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.search(existing_name))
    new_has_meal = bool(_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.search(new_name))
    if existing_has_meal and not new_has_meal:
        event.name = new_name
    elif not existing_has_meal and new_has_meal:
        pass  # keep existing (no meal keyword)
    elif existing_has_meal and new_has_meal:
        # Both have meal keywords — strip the meal keyword from existing
        stripped = _MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.sub("", existing_name).strip()
        stripped = re.sub(r"\s{2,}", " ", stripped)
        if stripped:
            event.name = stripped

    for field in ("image_url", "external_url", "address"):
        existing_val = getattr(event, field, "")
        new_val = defaults.get(field, "")
        if not existing_val and new_val:
            setattr(event, field, new_val)

    event.save()
    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
    return event


class EventIngestView(APIView):
    """POST /api/region-events/ingest/

    Receives a batch of scraped events and upserts them as RegionEvent records.
    """

    authentication_classes = [SharedSecretAuthentication]
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        serializer = IngestRequestSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        data = serializer.validated_data

        # Look up the EventSource
        source_key: str = data["source_key"]
        replace_existing_attachment_events = bool(
            data.get("replace_existing_attachment_events")
        )
        try:
            event_source = EventSource.objects.get(source_key=source_key)
        except EventSource.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"detail": f"Unknown source_key: {source_key}"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        if not event_source.is_enabled:
            return Response(
                {"detail": f"Event source '{source_key}' is disabled."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        system_user = get_system_calendar_user()
        created = 0
        updated = 0
        skipped = 0
        errors = 0

        if replace_existing_attachment_events:
            incoming_food_external_ids = {
                str(event_data["external_id"])
                for event_data in data["events"]
                if (event_data.get("category") or event_source.default_category)
                == "FOOD"
            }
            deactivated = _deactivate_missing_attachment_events(
                event_source=event_source,
                incoming_external_ids=incoming_food_external_ids,
            )
            if deactivated:
                logger.info(
                    "Deactivated %s stale attachment event(s) for source '%s'",
                    deactivated,
                    source_key,
                )

        for event_data in data["events"]:
            try:
                start_date = event_data["start_date"]
                end_date = event_data.get("end_date") or start_date
                recurrence_pattern = event_data.get("recurrence_pattern") or "NONE"
                recurrence_days = event_data.get("recurrence_days") or ""
                recurrence_end_date = event_data.get("recurrence_end_date")
                description = sanitize_event_description(
                    event_data.get("description", "")
                )
                if recurrence_pattern == "WEEKLY":
                    alignment = align_weekly_recurrence(
                        title=event_data.get("title", ""),
                        description=event_data.get("description", ""),
                        start_date=start_date,
                        recurrence_days=recurrence_days,
                    )
                    recurrence_days = alignment.days
                    if alignment.start_date != start_date:
                        end_date = end_date + (alignment.start_date - start_date)
                        start_date = alignment.start_date
                    if alignment.warnings:
                        logger.warning(
                            "Weekly recurrence aligned for '%s' (%s): %s",
                            event_data.get("title", "?"),
                            event_data.get("external_id", "?"),
                            ",".join(alignment.warnings),
                        )

                _validate_recurrence_window(
                    start_date=start_date,
                    recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                    recurrence_end_date=recurrence_end_date,
                )

                start_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(start_date, time.min))
                end_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                    datetime.combine(end_date, time(23, 59, 59))
                )

                # Cross-source dedup: only check for new events.
                already_exists = RegionEvent.objects.filter(
                    event_source=event_source,
                    external_id=event_data["external_id"],
                ).exists()
                if not already_exists:
                    title = event_data["title"]
                    cross_dup = RegionEventDedupService.find_cross_source_duplicate(
                        event_source.region_calendar,
                        title,
                        start_dt,
                        exclude_event_source_id=event_source.id,
                    )
                    if cross_dup:
                        logger.info(
                            "Skipping scraped event '%s' — cross-source duplicate "
                            "of '%s'",
                            title,
                            cross_dup.name,
                        )
                        skipped += 1
                        continue

                defaults = {
                    "name": event_data["title"],
                    "description": description,
                    "start_datetime": start_dt,
                    "end_datetime": end_dt,
                    "location": event_data.get("location", ""),
                    "meal_period": event_data.get("meal_period") or None,
                    "external_url": event_data.get("external_url", ""),
                    "image_url": event_data.get("image_url", ""),
                    "category": event_data.get("category")
                    or event_source.default_category,
                    "recurrence_pattern": recurrence_pattern,
                    "recurrence_days": recurrence_days,
                    "recurrence_end_date": recurrence_end_date,
                    "region_calendar": event_source.region_calendar,
                    "created_by": system_user,
                    "is_active": True,
                }
                if "address" in event_data:
                    defaults["address"] = event_data.get("address", "")
                if "source_confidence" in event_data:
                    defaults["source_confidence"] = event_data.get("source_confidence")
                flyer_image = event_data.get("flyer_image")
                incoming_image_url = str(event_data.get("image_url", "") or "")

                if not already_exists:
                    same_source_dup = (
                        RegionEventDedupService.find_same_source_near_duplicate(
                            event_source,
                            name=event_data["title"],
                            start_datetime=start_dt,
                            location=event_data.get("location", ""),
                            description=description,
                            meal_period=event_data.get("meal_period") or None,
                            recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                            recurrence_days=recurrence_days,
                            category=event_data.get("category")
                            or event_source.default_category,
                        )
                    )
                    if same_source_dup:
                        logger.info(
                            "Updating same-source near-duplicate '%s' using existing event %s",
                            event_data["title"],
                            same_source_dup.pk,
                        )
                        with transaction.atomic():
                            event = _apply_existing_event_update(
                                same_source_dup, defaults
                            )
                            _sync_uploaded_flyer(
                                event=event,
                                flyer_image=flyer_image,
                                incoming_image_url=incoming_image_url,
                            )
                        updated += 1
                        continue

                if not already_exists:
                    meal_merge = (
                        RegionEventDedupService.find_same_venue_meal_merge_candidate(
                            event_source,
                            name=event_data["title"],
                            start_datetime=start_dt,
                            location=event_data.get("location", ""),
                            category=event_data.get("category")
                            or event_source.default_category,
                            meal_period=event_data.get("meal_period") or None,
                        )
                    )
                    if meal_merge:
                        logger.info(
                            "Merging meal-period event '%s' into existing event %s",
                            event_data["title"],
                            meal_merge.pk,
                        )
                        with transaction.atomic():
                            event = _apply_meal_period_merge(meal_merge, defaults)
                            _sync_uploaded_flyer(
                                event=event,
                                flyer_image=flyer_image,
                                incoming_image_url=incoming_image_url,
                            )
                        updated += 1
                        continue

                with transaction.atomic():
                    event, was_created = RegionEvent.objects.update_or_create(
                        event_source=event_source,
                        external_id=event_data["external_id"],
                        defaults=defaults,
                    )
                    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
                    _sync_uploaded_flyer(
                        event=event,
                        flyer_image=flyer_image,
                        incoming_image_url=incoming_image_url,
                    )

                if was_created:
                    created += 1
                else:
                    updated += 1

            except IntegrityError:
                # Concurrent insert race — row now exists, count as update
                updated += 1
            except Exception:
                logger.exception(
                    "Error ingesting event '%s' for source '%s'",
                    event_data.get("title", "?"),
                    source_key,
                )
                errors += 1

        response_status = (
            status.HTTP_207_MULTI_STATUS if errors > 0 else status.HTTP_200_OK
        )
        return Response(
            {
                "created": created,
                "updated": updated,
                "skipped": skipped,
                "errors": errors,
            },
            status=response_status,
        )

def _decode_flyer_bytes(content_base64: str) -> bytes:
    normalized = str(content_base64 or "").strip()
    if normalized.startswith("data:") and "," in normalized:
        normalized = normalized.split(",", 1)[1]
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError("Flyer image content is required")
    try:
        return base64.b64decode(normalized, validate=True)
    except binascii.Error as exc:
        raise ValueError("Flyer image payload is not valid base64") from exc


def _normalize_flyer_content_type(*, content_type: str, original_filename: str) -> str:
    normalized = str(content_type or "").strip().lower()
    if not normalized:
        guessed, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(original_filename or "")
        normalized = str(guessed or "").lower()
    if not normalized:
        normalized = "image/png"
    if normalized not in settings.ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported flyer image type: {normalized}")
    return normalized


def _flyer_extension(*, content_type: str, original_filename: str) -> str:
    extension = str(original_filename or "").strip()
    extension = extension.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in extension else ""
    if extension:
        return f".{extension}"
    guessed = mimetypes.guess_extension(content_type) or ".png"
    return ".jpg" if guessed == ".jpe" else guessed


def _store_flyer_image(
    *,
    event: RegionEvent,
    flyer_image: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    content_bytes = _decode_flyer_bytes(str(flyer_image.get("content_base64") or ""))
    if len(content_bytes) > settings.MAX_IMAGE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("Flyer image exceeds the maximum allowed size")

    original_filename = str(flyer_image.get("original_filename") or "")
    content_type = _normalize_flyer_content_type(
        content_type=str(flyer_image.get("content_type") or ""),
        original_filename=original_filename,
    )
    extension = _flyer_extension(
        content_type=content_type,
        original_filename=original_filename,
    )
    source_key = (
        str(getattr(getattr(event, "event_source", None), "source_key", "") or "region")
        .strip()
        .replace("/", "-")
    )
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content_bytes).hexdigest()
    file_key = f"region-events/flyers/{source_key}/{event.id}/{digest}{extension}"
    storage = storages["s3uploadEvents"]
    if not storage.exists(file_key):
        storage.save(file_key, ContentFile(content_bytes))
    return file_key, content_type


def _event_flyer_route(event: RegionEvent) -> str:
    return reverse("regions:event_flyer", kwargs={"event_id": event.id})


def _sync_uploaded_flyer(
    *,
    event: RegionEvent,
    flyer_image: dict[str, Any] | None,
    incoming_image_url: str,
) -> None:
    if flyer_image:
        try:
            file_key, content_type = _store_flyer_image(
                event=event,
                flyer_image=flyer_image,
            )
        except ValueError:
            logger.warning(
                "Skipping invalid flyer upload for region event %s",
                event.pk,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            return

        storage = storages["s3uploadEvents"]
        previous_file_key = str(getattr(event, "flyer_file_key", "") or "")
        route = _event_flyer_route(event)
        update_fields: list[str] = []

        if previous_file_key and previous_file_key != file_key:
            storage.delete(previous_file_key)
        if event.flyer_file_key != file_key:
            event.flyer_file_key = file_key
            update_fields.append("flyer_file_key")
        if event.flyer_content_type != content_type:
            event.flyer_content_type = content_type
            update_fields.append("flyer_content_type")
        if event.image_url != route:
            event.image_url = route
            update_fields.append("image_url")
        if update_fields:
            event.save(update_fields=update_fields)
        return

        route = _event_flyer_route(event)
        if event.image_url != route:
            event.image_url = route
            event.save(update_fields=["image_url"])


def _attachment_group_key(external_id: str) -> str | None:
    parts = [part for part in str(external_id or "").split(":") if part]
    if len(parts) < 3:
        return None
    return ":".join(parts[:3])


def _deactivate_missing_attachment_events(
    *,
    event_source: EventSource,
    incoming_external_ids: set[str],
) -> int:
    if not incoming_external_ids:
        return 0

    group_keys = {
        key
        for external_id in incoming_external_ids
        if (key := _attachment_group_key(external_id))
    }
    if not group_keys:
        return 0

    stale_event_ids: list[int] = []
    for event in RegionEvent.objects.filter(
        event_source=event_source,
        category="FOOD",
        is_active=True,
    ).exclude(external_id=""):
        group_key = _attachment_group_key(event.external_id)
        if group_key in group_keys and event.external_id not in incoming_external_ids:
            stale_event_ids.append(event.id)

    if not stale_event_ids:
        return 0

    return RegionEvent.objects.filter(id__in=stale_event_ids).update(is_active=False)


#: Scraped DAILY/WEEKLY events without an explicit end date only render for
#: this many days past their start; reposts refresh the window.
SCRAPED_RECURRENCE_HORIZON_DAYS = 14


def _default_scraper_recurrence_horizon(
    *,
    event_source: EventSource,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    start_date: date,
    recurrence_end_date: date | None,
) -> date | None:
    if recurrence_end_date is not None:
        return recurrence_end_date
    if event_source.source_type != "SCRAPER":
        return None
    if recurrence_pattern not in ("DAILY", "WEEKLY"):
        return None
    return start_date + timedelta(days=SCRAPED_RECURRENCE_HORIZON_DAYS)


def _validate_recurrence_window(
    *,
    start_date: date,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    recurrence_end_date: date | None,
) -> None:
    if recurrence_pattern == "NONE":
        return

    if recurrence_end_date is None:
        return

    if recurrence_end_date < start_date:
        raise ValueError("recurrence_end_date cannot be earlier than start_date")


_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:breakfast|brunch|lunch|dinner|all[- ]?day)\b", re.IGNORECASE
)


def _apply_existing_event_update(
    event: RegionEvent, defaults: dict[str, Any]
) -> RegionEvent:
    defaults = dict(defaults)
    new_start = defaults.get("start_datetime")
    if (
        event.recurrence_pattern == "NONE"
        and new_start is not None
        and timezone.localtime(new_start).date()
        != timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime).date()
    ):
        # A non-recurring event must never migrate to a different day via a
        # repost match — that is how per-day items collapsed into one row.
        logger.warning(
            "Refusing to move non-recurring region event %s from %s to %s",
            event.pk,
            event.start_datetime.date(),
            new_start.date(),
        )
        defaults.pop("start_datetime", None)
        defaults.pop("end_datetime", None)
    for field, value in defaults.items():
        setattr(event, field, value)
    event.save()
    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
    return event


def _apply_meal_period_merge(
    event: RegionEvent, defaults: dict[str, Any]
) -> RegionEvent:
    """Merge a new meal-period event into an existing one from the same venue."""
    new_desc = str(defaults.get("description", "") or "")
    if new_desc:
        existing_lines = set(event.description.strip().splitlines())
        extra_lines = [
            line
            for line in new_desc.strip().splitlines()
            if line.strip() and line.strip() not in existing_lines
        ]
        if extra_lines:
            combined = event.description.rstrip()
            if combined:
                combined += "\n"
            combined += "\n".join(extra_lines)
            event.description = combined

    event.meal_period = None

    new_start = defaults.get("start_datetime", event.start_datetime)
    new_end = defaults.get("end_datetime", event.end_datetime)
    event.start_datetime = min(event.start_datetime, new_start)
    # Meal merges only combine same-day cards; the end must stay on the
    # start day or repeated reposts grow the event into a permanent card.
    local_start = timezone.localtime(event.start_datetime)
    end_of_day = local_start.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0)
    event.end_datetime = min(max(event.end_datetime, new_end), end_of_day)

    existing_name = str(event.name or "")
    new_name = str(defaults.get("name", "") or "")
    existing_has_meal = bool(_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.search(existing_name))
    new_has_meal = bool(_MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.search(new_name))
    if existing_has_meal and not new_has_meal:
        event.name = new_name
    elif not existing_has_meal and new_has_meal:
        pass  # keep existing (no meal keyword)
    elif existing_has_meal and new_has_meal:
        # Both have meal keywords — strip the meal keyword from existing
        stripped = _MEAL_KEYWORDS_RE.sub("", existing_name).strip()
        stripped = re.sub(r"\s{2,}", " ", stripped)
        if stripped:
            event.name = stripped

    for field in ("image_url", "external_url", "address"):
        existing_val = getattr(event, field, "")
        new_val = defaults.get(field, "")
        if not existing_val and new_val:
            setattr(event, field, new_val)

    event.save()
    queue_region_event_place_enrichment(event)
    return event


class EventIngestView(APIView):
    """POST /api/region-events/ingest/

    Receives a batch of scraped events and upserts them as RegionEvent records.
    """

    authentication_classes = [SharedSecretAuthentication]
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        serializer = IngestRequestSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        data = serializer.validated_data

        # Look up the EventSource
        source_key: str = data["source_key"]
        replace_existing_attachment_events = bool(
            data.get("replace_existing_attachment_events")
        )
        try:
            event_source = EventSource.objects.get(source_key=source_key)
        except EventSource.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"detail": f"Unknown source_key: {source_key}"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        if not event_source.is_enabled:
            return Response(
                {"detail": f"Event source '{source_key}' is disabled."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        system_user = get_system_calendar_user()
        created = 0
        updated = 0
        skipped = 0
        errors = 0

        if replace_existing_attachment_events:
            incoming_food_external_ids = {
                str(event_data["external_id"])
                for event_data in data["events"]
                if (event_data.get("category") or event_source.default_category)
                == "FOOD"
            }
            deactivated = _deactivate_missing_attachment_events(
                event_source=event_source,
                incoming_external_ids=incoming_food_external_ids,
            )
            if deactivated:
                logger.info(
                    "Deactivated %s stale attachment event(s) for source '%s'",
                    deactivated,
                    source_key,
                )

        for event_data in data["events"]:
            try:
                start_date = event_data["start_date"]
                end_date = event_data.get("end_date") or start_date
                recurrence_pattern = event_data.get("recurrence_pattern") or "NONE"
                recurrence_days = event_data.get("recurrence_days") or ""
                recurrence_end_date = event_data.get("recurrence_end_date")
                description = sanitize_event_description(
                    event_data.get("description", "")
                )
                if recurrence_pattern == "WEEKLY":
                    alignment = align_weekly_recurrence(
                        title=event_data.get("title", ""),
                        description=event_data.get("description", ""),
                        start_date=start_date,
                        recurrence_days=recurrence_days,
                    )
                    recurrence_days = alignment.days
                    if alignment.start_date != start_date:
                        end_date = end_date + (alignment.start_date - start_date)
                        start_date = alignment.start_date
                    if alignment.warnings:
                        logger.warning(
                            "Weekly recurrence aligned for '%s' (%s): %s",
                            event_data.get("title", "?"),
                            event_data.get("external_id", "?"),
                            ",".join(alignment.warnings),
                        )

                _validate_recurrence_window(
                    start_date=start_date,
                    recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                    recurrence_end_date=recurrence_end_date,
                )

                start_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(start_date, time.min))
                end_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                    datetime.combine(end_date, time(23, 59, 59))
                )

                # Cross-source dedup: only check for new events.
                already_exists = RegionEvent.objects.filter(
                    event_source=event_source,
                    external_id=event_data["external_id"],
                ).exists()
                if not already_exists:
                    title = event_data["title"]
                    cross_dup = RegionEventDedupService.find_cross_source_duplicate(
                        event_source.region_calendar,
                        title,
                        start_dt,
                        exclude_event_source_id=event_source.id,
                    )
                    if cross_dup:
                        logger.info(
                            "Skipping scraped event '%s' — cross-source duplicate "
                            "of '%s'",
                            title,
                            cross_dup.name,
                        )
                        skipped += 1
                        continue

                defaults = {
                    "name": event_data["title"],
                    "description": description,
                    "start_datetime": start_dt,
                    "end_datetime": end_dt,
                    "location": event_data.get("location", ""),
                    "meal_period": event_data.get("meal_period") or None,
                    "external_url": event_data.get("external_url", ""),
                    "image_url": event_data.get("image_url", ""),
                    "category": event_data.get("category")
                    or event_source.default_category,
                    "recurrence_pattern": recurrence_pattern,
                    "recurrence_days": recurrence_days,
                    "recurrence_end_date": recurrence_end_date,
                    "region_calendar": event_source.region_calendar,
                    "created_by": system_user,
                    "is_active": True,
                }
                if "address" in event_data:
                    defaults["address"] = event_data.get("address", "")
                if "source_confidence" in event_data:
                    defaults["source_confidence"] = event_data.get("source_confidence")
                flyer_image = event_data.get("flyer_image")
                incoming_image_url = str(event_data.get("image_url", "") or "")

                if not already_exists:
                    same_source_dup = (
                        RegionEventDedupService.find_same_source_near_duplicate(
