            recurrence_days = ""
            recurrence_end_date = None
            notes = "heuristic analyzer"
            if recurring:
                recurrence_pattern, recurrence_days, recurrence_end_date = recurring
                item_date = self._next_occurrence(_weekday_from_days(recurrence_days))

            title = self._extract_title(package, attachment, fallback_index=index)
            meal_period = (

                            attachment.title if attachment else "",
                        )
                        if part
                    )
                )
                if content_type == ContentType.FOOD
                else None
            )
            location = self._extract_location(package.combined_text())
            if content_type == ContentType.FOOD:
                title = _normalize_food_title(
                    raw_title=title,
                    location=location,
                    meal_period=meal_period,
                )
            items.append(
                NormalizedItem(
                    package_key=package.package_key,
                    external_id=_build_item_external_id(
                        package_key=package.package_key,
                        file_id=file_id,
                        title=title,

            )

        collapsed_items = _collapse_food_items(
            package=package,

        )

        analyzed = AnalyzedPackage(
            package=package,

            items=collapsed_items,
            debug={
                "provider": "heuristic",
                "parsed_output": {
                    "image_classifications": [

                    ],

            package=package,
            analyzed=analyzed,

    def _reference_day(self) -> date:
        return self._reference_date or date.today()

    def _build_target_text(self, package: SlackMessagePackage, attachment) -> str:
        parts = []
        if attachment:
            if attachment.title:
                parts.append(attachment.title)
            parts.append(attachment.name)
        parts.append(package.combined_text())
        return "\n".join(part for part in parts if part).lower()

    def _infer_content_type(self, text: str) -> ContentType | None:
        if any(keyword in text for keyword in _IGNORE_KEYWORDS):
            return None
        if any(keyword in text for keyword in _FOOD_KEYWORDS):
            return ContentType.FOOD
        if any(keyword in text for keyword in _EVENT_KEYWORDS):
            return ContentType.EVENT
        return None

    def _infer_target_content_type(
        self, package: SlackMessagePackage, attachment
    ) -> ContentType | None:
        if attachment:
            attachment_text = " ".join(
                part for part in [attachment.title, attachment.name] if part
            ).lower()
            attachment_type = self._infer_content_type(attachment_text)
            if attachment_type is not None:
                return attachment_type
        return self._infer_content_type(package.combined_text().lower())

    def _extract_recurrence(self, text: str) -> tuple[str, str, date | None] | None:
        if "every day" in text or "daily" in text:
            return ("DAILY", "", self._extract_recurrence_end_date(text))

        for weekday, index in _WEEKDAY_TO_INDEX.items():
            if f"every {weekday}" in text:
                return ("WEEKLY", str(index), self._extract_recurrence_end_date(text))

        return None

    def _extract_recurrence_end_date(self, text: str) -> date | None:
        match = re.search(r"through ([a-z]+ \d{1,2})", text)
        if not match:
            return None
        return self._parse_date(match.group(1), year=self._reference_day().year)

    def _extract_date(self, text: str) -> date | None:
        if "today" in text or "tonight" in text:
            return self._reference_day()
        if "tomorrow" in text:
            return self._reference_day() + timedelta(days=1)

        month_day = re.search(
            r"(january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december)\s+\d{1,2}",
            text,
        )
        if month_day:
            return self._parse_date(month_day.group(0), year=self._reference_day().year)

        if "this weekend" in text:
            return self._reference_day() + timedelta(
                days=max(5 - self._reference_day().weekday(), 0)
            )
        if "this week" in text:
            return self._reference_day()
        return None

    def _parse_date(self, raw: str, *, year: int) -> date | None:
        try:
            default = datetime(year, 1, 1)
            return dateutil_parser.parse(raw, default=default).date()
        except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
            return None

    def _infer_timing(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        start_date: date | None,
        recurring: bool,
    ) -> TimingBucket:
        if any(keyword in text for keyword in _IGNORE_KEYWORDS):
            return TimingBucket.IGNORE
        if recurring:
            return TimingBucket.RECURRING
        if start_date is None:
            return TimingBucket.IGNORE
        if start_date <= self._end_of_week():
            return TimingBucket.THIS_WEEK
        return TimingBucket.LATER

    def _extract_title(
        self,
        package: SlackMessagePackage,
        attachment,
        *,
        fallback_index: int,
    ) -> str:
        if (
            attachment
            and attachment.title
            and not _looks_like_generic_attachment_title(attachment.title)
        ):
            return attachment.title.strip()
        first_line = package.message_text.strip().splitlines()[0].strip()
        if first_line:
            return first_line[:120]
        return f"Slack item {fallback_index + 1}"

    def _extract_location(self, text: str) -> str:
        match = re.search(r"at ([a-z0-9'&.\-\s]+)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
        if not match:
            return ""
        return match.group(1).strip().rstrip(".")

    def _end_of_week(self) -> date:
        return self._reference_day() + timedelta(
            days=(6 - self._reference_day().weekday())
        )

    def _next_occurrence(self, weekday: int | None) -> date:
        if weekday is None:
            return self._reference_day()
        delta = (weekday - self._reference_day().weekday()) % 7
        return self._reference_day() + timedelta(days=delta)


class OpenAIAnalyzer:
    provider = "openai"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        model: str,
        api_key: str,
        timezone: str,
        reference_date: date | None = None,
        completion_client=None,
        fallback_analyzer: Analyzer | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.model = model
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.timezone = timezone
        self._reference_date = reference_date
        self._client = completion_client or OpenAI(api_key=api_key).chat.completions
        self._fallback = fallback_analyzer

    def analyze_package(self, package: SlackMessagePackage) -> AnalyzedPackage:
        try:
            raw, raw_text = self._call_model(package)
            analyzed = self._build_analyzed_package(
                package,
                raw,
                notes_prefix="openai",
                provider="openai",
                raw_output=raw_text,
                model=self.model,
            )
            reviewed = self._maybe_review(package, raw, analyzed)
            return _apply_quality_gate(
                package=package,
                analyzed=reviewed,
                reference_date=self._reference_day(),
                judge=self._judge_quality_gate,
            )
        except Exception:
            if self._fallback is None:
                raise
            _log.exception("OpenAI analyzer failed for %s", package.package_key)
            return self._fallback.analyze_package(package)

    def _call_model(self, package: SlackMessagePackage) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
        response = self._client.create(
            model=self.model,
            messages=[
                {
                    "role": "system",
                    "content": "You extract structured food specials and local events from Slack posts. Output JSON only.",
                },
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": _build_openai_multimodal_content(
                        package,
                        _build_extraction_prompt(
                            package, self.timezone, self._reference_day()
                        ),
                    ),
                },
            ],
            temperature=0,
        )
        text = _normalize_model_text(response.choices[0].message.content)
        return _parse_model_json(text), text

    def _review_model(
        self, package: SlackMessagePackage, raw: dict[str, Any], reasons: list[str]

            messages=[

                    "role": "user",

                            current_raw=raw,

                        ),
                    ),

        )

    def _maybe_review(
        self,

        reasons = _review_reasons(package=package, raw=raw)

    def _build_analyzed_package(
        self,
        package: SlackMessagePackage,
        raw: dict[str, Any],
        *,
        notes_prefix: str,
        provider: str,
        raw_output: str,
        model: str,
    ) -> AnalyzedPackage:
        return _build_analyzed_package(
            package=package,
            raw=raw,
            reference_date=self._reference_day(),
            notes_prefix=notes_prefix,
            provider=provider,
            raw_output=raw_output,
            model=model,
        )

    def _reference_day(self) -> date:
        return self._reference_date or date.today()


class GeminiAnalyzer:
    provider = "gemini"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        model: str,
        api_key: str,
        timezone: str,
        reference_date: date | None = None,
        client=None,
        fallback_analyzer: Analyzer | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.model = model
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.timezone = timezone
        self._reference_date = reference_date
        self._client = client
        self._fallback = fallback_analyzer

    def analyze_package(self, package: SlackMessagePackage) -> AnalyzedPackage:
        try:
            raw, raw_text = self._call_model(package)
            analyzed = _build_analyzed_package(
                package=package,
                raw=raw,
                reference_date=self._reference_day(),
                notes_prefix="gemini",
                provider="gemini",
                raw_output=raw_text,
                model=self.model,
            )
            reviewed = self._maybe_review(package, raw, analyzed)
            return _apply_quality_gate(
                package=package,
                analyzed=reviewed,
                reference_date=self._reference_day(),
                judge=self._judge_quality_gate,
            )
        except Exception:
            if self._fallback is None:
                raise
            _log.exception("Gemini analyzer failed for %s", package.package_key)
            return self._fallback.analyze_package(package)

    def _call_model(self, package: SlackMessagePackage) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
        if self._client is None:
            try:
                from google import genai
            except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - exercised in runtime env
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "google-genai is required for Gemini fallback"
                ) from exc
            self._client = genai.Client(api_key=self.api_key)

        response = self._client.models.generate_content(
            model=self.model,
            contents=_build_gemini_multimodal_content(
                package,
                _build_extraction_prompt(package, self.timezone, self._reference_day()),
            ),
        )
        text = _normalize_model_text(getattr(response, "text", None))
        if not text:
            raise RuntimeError("Gemini returned an empty response")
        return _parse_model_json(text), text

    def _review_model(
        self, package: SlackMessagePackage, raw: dict[str, Any], reasons: list[str]
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
        response = self._client.models.generate_content(
            model=self.model,
            contents=_build_gemini_multimodal_content(
                package,
                _build_review_prompt(
                    package=package,
                    timezone=self.timezone,
                    reference_date=self._reference_day(),
                    current_raw=raw,
                    reasons=reasons,
                ),
            ),
        )
        text = _normalize_model_text(getattr(response, "text", None))
        if not text:
            raise RuntimeError("Gemini review returned an empty response")
        return _parse_model_json(text), text

    def _judge_quality_gate(
        self,
        package: SlackMessagePackage,
        raw: dict[str, Any],
        analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
        reasons: list[str],
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
        response = self._client.models.generate_content(
            model=self.model,
            contents=_build_gemini_multimodal_content(
                package,
                _build_quality_gate_prompt(
                    package=package,
                    current_raw=raw,
                    analyzed=analyzed,
                    reasons=reasons,
                ),
            ),
        )
        text = _normalize_model_text(getattr(response, "text", None))
        if not text:
            raise RuntimeError("Gemini quality gate returned an empty response")
        return _parse_model_json(text), text

    def _maybe_review(
        self,
        package: SlackMessagePackage,
        raw: dict[str, Any],
        analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
    ) -> AnalyzedPackage:
        reasons = _review_reasons(package=package, raw=raw)
        if not reasons:
            return analyzed
        try:
            reviewed_raw, reviewed_text = self._review_model(package, raw, reasons)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            analyzed.debug = {
                **analyzed.debug,
                "review": {
                    "triggered": True,
                    "accepted": False,
                    "reasons": reasons,
                    "error": str(exc),
                },
            }
            _log.warning(
                "Gemini review pass failed for %s: %s", package.package_key, exc
            )
            return analyzed

        reviewed = _build_analyzed_package(
            package=package,
            raw=reviewed_raw,
            reference_date=self._reference_day(),
            notes_prefix="gemini-review",
            provider="gemini",
            raw_output=reviewed_text,
            model=self.model,
        )
        reviewed.debug = {
            **reviewed.debug,
            "review": {
                "triggered": True,
                "accepted": True,
                "reasons": reasons,
                "raw_output": reviewed_text,
                "parsed_output": reviewed_raw,
            },
        }
        return reviewed

    def _reference_day(self) -> date:
        return self._reference_date or date.today()


class RedundantAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self, analyzers: list[Analyzer]):
        self.analyzers = analyzers

    def analyze_package(self, package: SlackMessagePackage) -> AnalyzedPackage:
        attempts: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        last_exc: Exception | None = None
        for analyzer in self.analyzers:
            provider = getattr(analyzer, "provider", analyzer.__class__.__name__)
            try:
                result = analyzer.analyze_package(package)
                result.debug = {
                    **result.debug,
                    "attempts": [
                        *attempts,
                        {
                            "provider": str(result.debug.get("provider") or provider),
                            "status": "success",
                        },
                    ],
                }
                return result
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                last_exc = exc
                attempts.append(
                    {
                        "provider": str(provider),
                        "status": "failed",
                        "error": str(exc),
                    }
                )
                _log.warning(
                    "Analyzer %s failed for %s; trying next analyzer: %s",
                    analyzer.__class__.__name__,
                    package.package_key,
                    exc,
                )
        if last_exc is not None:
            raise last_exc
        raise RuntimeError("No analyzers configured")


def build_default_analyzer(region, *, reference_date: date | None = None) -> Analyzer:
    heuristic = HeuristicAnalyzer(reference_date=reference_date)
    analyzers: list[Analyzer] = []
    model = region.model
    model_lower = model.lower()
    openai_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    gemini_key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY")

    if openai_key and _model_prefers_openai(model_lower):
        analyzers.append(
            OpenAIAnalyzer(
                model=model,
                api_key=openai_key,
                timezone=region.timezone,
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
        )
    if gemini_key:
        gemini_model = model if model_lower.startswith("gemini") else "gemini-2.5-flash"
        analyzers.append(
            GeminiAnalyzer(
                model=gemini_model,
                api_key=gemini_key,
                timezone=region.timezone,
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
        )
    if openai_key and not analyzers:
        analyzers.append(
            OpenAIAnalyzer(
                model="gpt-4o-mini",
                api_key=openai_key,
                timezone=region.timezone,
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
        )
    analyzers.append(heuristic)

    if len(analyzers) == 1:
        return analyzers[0]
    return RedundantAnalyzer(analyzers)


def _build_extraction_prompt(
    package: SlackMessagePackage, timezone: str, reference_date: date
) -> str:
    end_of_week = reference_date + timedelta(days=(6 - reference_date.weekday()))
    attachments = package.attachments or []
    attachment_lines = [
        f"- {attachment.file_id}: title={attachment.title or '[none]'}; name={attachment.name or '[none]'}"
        for attachment in attachments
    ]
    if not attachment_lines:
        attachment_lines = ["- none"]
    return (
        "Analyze this Slack package and extract any food specials or local events.\n"
        f"Today is {reference_date.isoformat()} in timezone {timezone}.\n"
        f"Reference date: {reference_date.isoformat()}.\n"
        f"This week ends on: {end_of_week.isoformat()} in timezone {timezone}.\n"
        "Timing rules:\n"
        "- Something described as today or tonight should use the reference date.\n"
        "- Something described as tomorrow should use the day after the reference date.\n"
        "- THIS_WEEK: dated between the reference date and end of week.\n"
        "- LATER: dated after end of week.\n"
        "- RECURRING: repeats weekly or daily.\n"
        "- IGNORE: no actionable special/event.\n"
        "Extraction rules:\n"
        "- For restaurant specials boards or menu flyers, prefer one FOOD item per attachment or post.\n"
        "- Put the dish list or day-by-day menu into the summary field using line breaks.\n"
        "- For FOOD items, include all customer-visible offer text in summary, including drink discounts and add-on promos.\n"
        "- If same-venue/day beverage offers are found in the caption text, emit them as FOOD lines/items instead of dropping them.\n"
        "- Use notes only for diagnostic extraction comments, not public-facing promo copy.\n"
        "- Set meal_period only when the text explicitly says Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, or All Day.\n"
        "- Do not guess meal_period from venue hours, generic event times, or opening hours.\n"
        "- If multiple meal periods appear and one is not clearly the singular label for the special, leave meal_period null.\n"
        "- If a FOOD flyer covers multiple concrete days, return one FOOD item per concrete day instead of one spanning range.\n"
        "- Only split FOOD into multiple items when the same image clearly contains unrelated venues or unrelated promotions.\n"
        "- Do not mark FOOD as recurring from a weekday label alone.\n"
        "- Use WEEKLY or DAILY only when the image, caption, or text explicitly says every Friday, Fridays, weekly, every week, daily, or another clear repeat cue.\n"
        "- If package context gives a concrete date like Friday March 27th Specials, default to a single dated special unless the attachment itself clearly states recurrence.\n"
        "- Restaurant discount nights and menu specials should usually be FOOD unless the primary content is entertainment.\n"
        "- For non-recurring EVENT items, you must return a concrete start_date when the flyer or text gives any usable date clue.\n"
        "- If the flyer shows a month and day without a year, infer the year from the reference date.\n"
        "- If the flyer shows a weekday plus month/day and time, convert that into a concrete ISO date.\n"
        "- When a flyer includes a venue name and a full street address, put the venue name in location and the street/city/state in address.\n"
        "- Only leave start_date null when the package truly contains no usable date.\n"
        "Classify each attachment separately when possible.\n"
        "Return JSON only with this shape:\n"
        "{"
        '"image_classifications":[{"file_id":"string","content_type":"FOOD|EVENT|null","timing":"THIS_WEEK|LATER|RECURRING|IGNORE","confidence":0.0,"notes":"string"}],'
        '"items":[{"file_id":"string|null","title":"string","summary":"string","content_type":"FOOD|EVENT","timing":"THIS_WEEK|LATER|RECURRING","start_date":"YYYY-MM-DD|null","end_date":"YYYY-MM-DD|null","recurrence_pattern":"NONE|DAILY|WEEKLY","recurrence_days":"comma-separated weekday indexes 0-6","recurrence_end_date":"YYYY-MM-DD|null","meal_period":"BREAKFAST|LUNCH|DINNER|BRUNCH|ALL_DAY|null","location":"string","address":"string","confidence":0.0,"notes":"string"}]'
        "}\n"
        f"Message text:\n{package.message_text or '[none]'}\n"
        f"Thread text:\n{package.thread_texts or []}\n"
        "Attachments:\n" + "\n".join(attachment_lines)
    )

def _build_openai_multimodal_content(
    package: SlackMessagePackage, prompt: str
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    content: list[dict[str, Any]] = [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}]
    for attachment in package.attachments:
        content.append(
            {
                "type": "text",
                "text": (
                    f"Attachment {attachment.file_id}: "
                    f"title={attachment.title or '[none]'}, name={attachment.name or '[none]'}"
                ),
            }
        )
        if attachment.content_bytes:
            encoded = base64.b64encode(attachment.content_bytes).decode("ascii")
            content.append(
                {
                    "type": "image_url",
                    "image_url": {
                        "url": f"data:{attachment.mimetype};base64,{encoded}",
                    },
                }
            )
    return content


def _build_gemini_multimodal_content(
    package: SlackMessagePackage, prompt: str
) -> list[Any]:
    contents: list[Any] = [prompt]
    for attachment in package.attachments:
        contents.append(
            f"Attachment {attachment.file_id}: title={attachment.title or '[none]'}, "
            f"name={attachment.name or '[none]'}"
        )
        if attachment.content_bytes:
            try:
                from google.genai import types as genai_types
            except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - exercised in runtime env
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "google-genai is required for Gemini fallback"
                ) from exc
            contents.append(
                genai_types.Part.from_bytes(
                    data=attachment.content_bytes,
                    mime_type=attachment.mimetype,
                )
            )
    return contents


def _review_reasons(*, package: SlackMessagePackage, raw: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    reasons: list[str] = []
    if package.attachments and not (raw.get("items") or []):
        reasons.append("attachments_without_items")
    if len(package.attachments) > 1:
        reasons.append("multi_image_package")

    confidences: list[float] = []
    for candidate in raw.get("image_classifications") or []:
        confidence = _raw_confidence(candidate.get("confidence"))
        if confidence is not None:
            confidences.append(confidence)
    for candidate in raw.get("items") or []:
        confidence = _raw_confidence(candidate.get("confidence"))
        if confidence is not None:
            confidences.append(confidence)
        content_type = str(candidate.get("content_type") or "").upper()
        recurrence_pattern = str(candidate.get("recurrence_pattern") or "NONE").upper()
        start_date = candidate.get("start_date")
        if (
            content_type == ContentType.EVENT.value
            and recurrence_pattern == "NONE"
            and start_date in (None, "")
        ):
            reasons.append("event_missing_start_date")
    if confidences and min(confidences) < _LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
        reasons.append("low_model_confidence")

    deduped: list[str] = []
    for reason in reasons:
        if reason not in deduped:
            deduped.append(reason)
    return deduped


def _raw_confidence(value: Any) -> float | None:
    if value in (None, ""):
        return None
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _parse_model_json(text: str | list[dict[str, Any]] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stripped = _normalize_model_text(text)
    if stripped.startswith("```"):
        stripped = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", stripped)
        stripped = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", stripped)
    match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", stripped, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        stripped = match.group(0)
    return json.loads(stripped)


def _build_analyzed_package(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    raw: dict[str, Any],
    reference_date: date,
    notes_prefix: str,
    provider: str,
    raw_output: str,
    model: str,
    food_summary_mode: str = "normalized",
    collapse_food: bool = True,
    preserve_food_titles: bool = False,
) -> AnalyzedPackage:
    image_classifications: list[ImageClassification] = []
    for attachment in package.attachments or [None]:
        file_id = attachment.file_id if attachment else f"{package.package_key}:message"
        raw_classification = _find_image_classification(
            raw.get("image_classifications") or [], file_id=file_id
        )
        image_classifications.append(
            ImageClassification(
                file_id=file_id,
                content_type=_parse_content_type(
                    raw_classification.get("content_type")
                ),
                timing=_parse_timing(
                    raw_classification.get("timing"), allow_ignore=True
                ),
                confidence=float(raw_classification.get("confidence") or 0.8),
                notes=str(
                    raw_classification.get("notes") or f"{notes_prefix} analyzer"
                ),
            )
        )

    items: list[NormalizedItem] = []
    for index, raw_item in enumerate(raw.get("items") or []):
        content_type = _parse_content_type(raw_item.get("content_type"))
        timing = _parse_timing(raw_item.get("timing"), allow_ignore=False)
        if content_type is None or timing is None:
            continue
        file_id = str(raw_item.get("file_id") or "")
        start_date = _parse_date(raw_item.get("start_date"))
        recurrence_end_date = _parse_date(raw_item.get("recurrence_end_date"))
        recurrence_pattern = str(raw_item.get("recurrence_pattern") or "NONE").upper()
        raw_title = str(raw_item.get("title") or f"Slack item {index + 1}")
        raw_summary = str(raw_item.get("summary") or package.combined_text())
        raw_notes = str(raw_item.get("notes") or "")
        location, address = _normalize_location_and_address(
            location=str(raw_item.get("location") or ""),
            address=str(raw_item.get("address") or ""),
        )
        meal_period = (
            _parse_meal_period(raw_item.get("meal_period"))
            or _detect_explicit_meal_period(
                "\n".join(
                    part
                    for part in (
                        raw_title,
                        raw_summary,
                        raw_notes,
                        package.message_text,
                        *package.thread_texts,
                    )
                    if part
                )
            )
            if content_type == ContentType.FOOD
            else None
        )
        if recurrence_pattern != "NONE" and start_date is None:
            start_date = _infer_recurring_start_date(
                recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                recurrence_days=str(raw_item.get("recurrence_days") or ""),
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
        if recurrence_pattern == "NONE" and start_date is None:
            start_date = _infer_missing_start_date(
                package=package,
                raw_item=raw_item,
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
        normalized_title = (
            raw_title.strip()
            if preserve_food_titles and raw_title.strip()
            else _normalize_food_title(
                raw_title=raw_title,
                location=location,
                meal_period=meal_period,
            )
            if content_type == ContentType.FOOD
            else raw_title
        )
        public_summary = (
            _merge_public_food_summary_and_note(raw_summary, raw_notes)
            if content_type == ContentType.FOOD
            else raw_summary
        )
        items.append(
            NormalizedItem(
                package_key=package.package_key,
                external_id=_build_item_external_id(
                    package_key=package.package_key,
                    file_id=file_id,
                    title=normalized_title,
                    start_date=start_date,
                    recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                    recurrence_days=str(raw_item.get("recurrence_days") or ""),
                    fallback_index=index,
                ),
                title=normalized_title,
                summary=(
                    _normalize_food_summary_text(public_summary)
                    if food_summary_mode == "normalized"
                    else _normalize_safe_food_summary_text(public_summary)
                )
                if content_type == ContentType.FOOD
                else raw_summary,
                content_type=content_type,
                timing=timing,
                start_date=start_date,
                end_date=_parse_date(raw_item.get("end_date")) or start_date,
                recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
                recurrence_days=str(raw_item.get("recurrence_days") or ""),
                recurrence_end_date=recurrence_end_date,
                meal_period=meal_period,
                location=location,
                address=address,
                image_file_ids=[file_id] if file_id else [],
                confidence=float(raw_item.get("confidence") or 0.8),
                notes=str(raw_item.get("notes") or f"{notes_prefix} analyzer"),
                source_title=raw_title,
            )
        )

    expanded_items = _expand_non_recurring_food_date_ranges(items)
    collapsed_items = (
        _collapse_food_items(
            package=package,
            items=expanded_items,
            reference_date=reference_date,
        )
        if collapse_food
        else expanded_items
    )

    return AnalyzedPackage(
        package=package,
        image_classifications=image_classifications,
        items=collapsed_items,
        debug={
            "provider": provider,
            "model": model,
            "raw_output": raw_output,
            "parsed_output": raw,
        },
    )


def _apply_quality_gate(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
    reference_date: date,
    judge: Callable[
        [SlackMessagePackage, dict[str, Any], AnalyzedPackage, list[str]],
        tuple[dict[str, Any], str],
    ]
    | None = None,
) -> AnalyzedPackage:
    raw = analyzed.debug.get("parsed_output")
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raw = {}
    heuristic_reasons = _quality_gate_reasons(
        package=package,
        raw=raw,
        analyzed=analyzed,
        reference_date=reference_date,
    )
    if not heuristic_reasons:
        analyzed.debug = {
            **analyzed.debug,
            "quality_gate": {
                "triggered": False,
                "accepted": True,
                "repair_mode": _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_NONE,
                "heuristic_reasons": [],
                "judge_reasons": [],
                "notes": "",
            },
        }
        return analyzed

    decision = _default_quality_gate_decision(heuristic_reasons)
    judge_output = ""
    judge_error = ""
    if judge is not None:
        try:
            decision_raw, judge_output = judge(
                package, raw, analyzed, heuristic_reasons
            )
            decision = _parse_quality_gate_decision(decision_raw)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            judge_error = str(exc)
            _log.warning(
                "Quality gate judge failed for %s: %s", package.package_key, judge_error
            )

    final_analyzed = analyzed
    repair_mode = decision["repair_mode"]
    judge_reasons = list(decision["reasons"])
    notes = str(decision["notes"])

    if repair_mode in {
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_SAFE_RAW,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_DISABLE_COLLAPSE,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_STRIP_RECURRENCE,
    }:
        if repair_mode != _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_STRIP_RECURRENCE:
            final_analyzed = _rebuild_analyzed_for_quality_gate(
                package=package,
                analyzed=analyzed,
                reference_date=reference_date,
                repair_mode=repair_mode,
            )
        remaining_reasons = _quality_gate_reasons(
            package=package,
            raw=raw,
            analyzed=final_analyzed,
            reference_date=reference_date,
        )
        # The strip pass must run after any rebuild: rebuilding regenerates
        # items from raw output and would resurrect the inferred recurrence.
        if "suspicious_recurrence_inference" in remaining_reasons:
            final_analyzed = _strip_suspicious_recurrence(
                package=package,
                analyzed=final_analyzed,
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
            remaining_reasons = _quality_gate_reasons(
                package=package,
                raw=raw,
                analyzed=final_analyzed,
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
        if remaining_reasons:
            repair_mode = _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_BLOCK
            if "repair_failed" not in judge_reasons:
                judge_reasons.append("repair_failed")
            if notes:
                notes = f"{notes} Remaining issues after repair: {', '.join(remaining_reasons)}."
            else:
                notes = (
                    "Repair did not fully resolve quality gate issues: "
                    + ", ".join(remaining_reasons)
                )

    if repair_mode == _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_BLOCK:
        accepted = False
    elif repair_mode in {
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_SAFE_RAW,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_DISABLE_COLLAPSE,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_STRIP_RECURRENCE,
    }:
        accepted = True
    else:
        accepted = bool(decision["accept"])

    quality_gate_debug = {
        "triggered": True,
        "accepted": accepted,
        "repair_mode": repair_mode,
        "heuristic_reasons": heuristic_reasons,
        "judge_reasons": judge_reasons,
        "notes": notes,
    }
    if judge_output:
        quality_gate_debug["raw_output"] = judge_output
    if judge_error:
        quality_gate_debug["judge_error"] = judge_error

    final_analyzed.debug = {
        **analyzed.debug,
        **final_analyzed.debug,
        "quality_gate": quality_gate_debug,
    }
    return final_analyzed


def _rebuild_analyzed_for_quality_gate(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
    reference_date: date,
    repair_mode: str,
) -> AnalyzedPackage:
    raw = analyzed.debug.get("parsed_output")
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return analyzed
    return _build_analyzed_package(
        package=package,
        raw=raw,
        reference_date=reference_date,
        notes_prefix=str(analyzed.debug.get("provider") or "quality-gate"),
        provider=str(analyzed.debug.get("provider") or "quality-gate"),
        raw_output=str(analyzed.debug.get("raw_output") or ""),
        model=str(analyzed.debug.get("model") or ""),
        food_summary_mode="safe_raw",
        collapse_food=repair_mode != _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_DISABLE_COLLAPSE,
        preserve_food_titles=repair_mode == _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_DISABLE_COLLAPSE,
    )


def _quality_gate_reasons(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    raw: dict[str, Any],
    analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
    reference_date: date,
) -> list[str]:
    reasons: list[str] = []
    final_food_items = [
        item for item in analyzed.items if item.content_type == ContentType.FOOD
    ]
    final_food_lines = _final_food_summary_lines(analyzed)
    raw_food_items = _raw_food_items(raw)

    if any(_QUALITY_GATE_MARKER_ONLY_RE.fullmatch(line) for line in final_food_lines):
        reasons.append("marker_only_public_lines")
    if any(_QUALITY_GATE_CONTINUATION_RE.match(line) for line in final_food_lines) and (
        not raw_food_items or len(final_food_items) < len(raw_food_items)
    ):
        reasons.append("collapsed_fragmentation")
    if _has_clipped_numeric_unit(
        raw_food_items=raw_food_items, final_lines=final_food_lines
    ):
        reasons.append("clipped_numeric_unit")
    if _has_numeric_token_loss(
        raw_food_items=raw_food_items, final_lines=final_food_lines
    ):
        reasons.append("numeric_token_loss")
    if _has_missing_customer_facing_food_note(
        raw_food_items=raw_food_items,
        final_lines=final_food_lines,
    ):
        reasons.append("promo_note_not_promoted")
    if _has_suspicious_recurrence_inference(
        package=package,
        raw_food_items=raw_food_items,
        analyzed=analyzed,
        reference_date=reference_date,
    ):
        reasons.append("suspicious_recurrence_inference")

    deduped: list[str] = []
    for reason in reasons:
        if reason not in deduped:
            deduped.append(reason)
    return deduped


def _parse_quality_gate_decision(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    repair_mode = str(raw.get("repair_mode") or _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_BLOCK).upper()
    if repair_mode not in {
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_NONE,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_SAFE_RAW,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_DISABLE_COLLAPSE,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_STRIP_RECURRENCE,
        _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_BLOCK,
    }:
        repair_mode = _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_BLOCK
    reasons = [
        str(reason)
        for reason in (raw.get("reasons") or [])
        if str(reason or "").strip()
    ]
    return {
        "accept": bool(raw.get("accept")),
        "repair_mode": repair_mode,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "notes": str(raw.get("notes") or ""),
    }


def _default_quality_gate_decision(heuristic_reasons: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    reason_set = set(heuristic_reasons)
    if "collapsed_fragmentation" in reason_set:
        repair_mode = _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_DISABLE_COLLAPSE
    elif reason_set & {
        "clipped_numeric_unit",
        "numeric_token_loss",
        "marker_only_public_lines",
        "promo_note_not_promoted",
    }:
        repair_mode = _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_SAFE_RAW
    elif "suspicious_recurrence_inference" in reason_set:
        # Item-level repair: demote the offending items to single-day
        # specials instead of blocking the whole package (which silently
        # blacked out venues whose posts always trip this heuristic).
        repair_mode = _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_STRIP_RECURRENCE
    else:
        repair_mode = _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_BLOCK
    return {
        "accept": repair_mode == _QUALITY_GATE_REPAIR_NONE,
        "repair_mode": repair_mode,
        "reasons": list(heuristic_reasons),
        "notes": "Applied default quality gate policy.",
    }


def _final_food_summary_lines(analyzed: AnalyzedPackage) -> list[str]:
    lines: list[str] = []
    for item in analyzed.items:
        if item.content_type != ContentType.FOOD:
            continue
        for piece in str(item.summary or "").splitlines():
            cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", piece).strip()
            if cleaned:
                lines.append(cleaned)
    return lines


def _raw_food_items(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for candidate in raw.get("items") or []:
        if _parse_content_type(candidate.get("content_type")) == ContentType.FOOD:
            items.append(candidate)
    return items


def _has_clipped_numeric_unit(
    *, raw_food_items: list[dict[str, Any]], final_lines: list[str]
) -> bool:
    if not final_lines:
        return False
    raw_text = "\n".join(
        str(candidate.get("summary") or "") for candidate in raw_food_items if candidate
    )
    has_raw_units = bool(
        _QUALITY_GATE_NUMERIC_UNIT_RE.search(raw_text)
        or re.search(r"\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?%\s*off\b", raw_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    )
    if not has_raw_units:
        return False
    return any(
        _QUALITY_GATE_CLIPPED_UNIT_RE.match(line)
        or _QUALITY_GATE_PERCENT_LOSS_RE.match(line)
        for line in final_lines
    )


def _has_numeric_token_loss(
    *, raw_food_items: list[dict[str, Any]], final_lines: list[str]
) -> bool:
    final_signatures = {
        _quality_gate_numeric_loss_signature(line) for line in final_lines if line
    }
    if not final_signatures:
        return False
    for raw_item in raw_food_items:
        raw_summary = str(raw_item.get("summary") or "")
        raw_notes = str(raw_item.get("notes") or "")
        public_summary = _merge_public_food_summary_and_note(raw_summary, raw_notes)
        for piece in public_summary.splitlines():
            cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", piece).strip()
            if not cleaned:
                continue
            clipped = _QUALITY_GATE_NUMERIC_PREFIX_RE.sub("", cleaned, count=1).strip()
            clipped = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", clipped).strip()
            if clipped != cleaned and clipped in final_signatures:
                return True
    return False


def _quality_gate_numeric_loss_signature(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value or "")).strip()


def _has_missing_customer_facing_food_note(
    *, raw_food_items: list[dict[str, Any]], final_lines: list[str]
) -> bool:
    final_text = "\n".join(final_lines).lower()
    for raw_item in raw_food_items:
        note = _clean_food_summary_fragment(str(raw_item.get("notes") or ""))
        if not note or not _looks_like_customer_facing_food_note(note):
            continue
        if note.lower() not in final_text:
            return True
    return False


def _has_suspicious_recurrence_inference(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    raw_food_items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
    reference_date: date,
) -> bool:
    return bool(
        _suspicious_recurrence_item_external_ids(
            package=package,
            raw_food_items=raw_food_items,
            analyzed=analyzed,
            reference_date=reference_date,
        )
    )


def _suspicious_recurrence_item_external_ids(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    raw_food_items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
    reference_date: date,
) -> list[str]:
    """Return external_ids of FOOD items whose recurrence looks invented."""
    package_context = "\n".join(
        part
        for part in (
            package.message_text,
            *package.thread_texts,
            *[
                "\n".join(part for part in (attachment.title, attachment.name) if part)
                for attachment in package.attachments
            ],
        )
        if part
    )
    if not package_context or not _looks_like_dated_food_context(
        package_context, reference_date
    ):
        return []
    explicit_repeat = _EXPLICIT_REPEAT_CUE_RE.search(package_context) is not None
    offending: list[str] = []
    for raw_item, final_item in zip(
        raw_food_items,
        [item for item in analyzed.items if item.content_type == ContentType.FOOD],
        strict=False,
    ):
        if final_item.recurrence_pattern not in {"WEEKLY", "DAILY"}:
            continue
        raw_context = "\n".join(
            part
            for part in (
                str(raw_item.get("title") or ""),
                str(raw_item.get("summary") or ""),
            )
            if part
        )
        if explicit_repeat or _EXPLICIT_REPEAT_CUE_RE.search(raw_context):
            continue
        offending.append(final_item.external_id)
    return offending


def _strip_suspicious_recurrence(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    analyzed: AnalyzedPackage,
    reference_date: date,
) -> AnalyzedPackage:
    """Demote suspiciously-recurring items to single-day specials.

    Item-level repair for suspicious_recurrence_inference: keeps the rest of
    the package publishable instead of blocking every sibling item.
    """
    raw = analyzed.debug.get("parsed_output")
    raw_food_items = _raw_food_items(raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {})
    offending = set(
        _suspicious_recurrence_item_external_ids(
            package=package,
            raw_food_items=raw_food_items,
            analyzed=analyzed,
            reference_date=reference_date,
        )
    )
    if not offending:
        return analyzed

    stripped_items: list[NormalizedItem] = []
    stripped_external_ids: list[str] = []
    for index, item in enumerate(analyzed.items):
        if item.external_id not in offending:
            stripped_items.append(item)
            continue
        start_date = item.start_date or reference_date
        file_id = item.image_file_ids[0] if item.image_file_ids else ""
        stripped_item = replace(
            item,
            recurrence_pattern="NONE",
            recurrence_days="",
            recurrence_end_date=None,
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=start_date,
            external_id=_build_item_external_id(
                package_key=item.package_key,
                file_id=file_id,
                title=item.title,
                start_date=start_date,
                recurrence_pattern="NONE",
                recurrence_days="",
                fallback_index=index,
            ),
            notes=(
                f"{item.notes} " if item.notes else ""
            )
            + "[quality gate stripped inferred recurrence]",
        )
        stripped_items.append(stripped_item)
        stripped_external_ids.append(stripped_item.external_id)

    return AnalyzedPackage(
        package=analyzed.package,
        image_classifications=analyzed.image_classifications,
        items=stripped_items,
        debug={
            **analyzed.debug,
            "stripped_item_external_ids": stripped_external_ids,
        },
    )


def _looks_like_dated_food_context(text: str, reference_date: date) -> bool:
    lowered = text.lower()
    if _CONCRETE_DATE_CUE_RE.search(text):
        return True
    if "today" in lowered or "tonight" in lowered or "tomorrow" in lowered:
        return True
    weekday_label = reference_date.strftime("%A").lower()
    return weekday_label in lowered and "special" in lowered


def _normalize_model_text(text: str | list[dict[str, Any]] | None) -> str:
    if isinstance(text, list):
        parts = []
        for block in text:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text":
                parts.append(str(block.get("text") or ""))
        text = "\n".join(parts)
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        raise RuntimeError("Model returned no JSON content")
    return text.strip()


def _find_image_classification(
    classifications: list[dict[str, Any]], *, file_id: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    for classification in classifications:
        if str(classification.get("file_id") or "") == file_id:
            return classification
    return {
        "file_id": file_id,
        "timing": "IGNORE",
        "confidence": 0.0,
        "notes": "not classified",
    }


def _parse_content_type(value: Any) -> ContentType | None:
    if value in (None, "", "null"):
        return None
    try:
        return ContentType(str(value).upper())
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _parse_timing(value: Any, *, allow_ignore: bool) -> TimingBucket | None:
    candidate = str(value or "").upper()
    if not candidate:
        return TimingBucket.IGNORE if allow_ignore else None
    try:
        timing = TimingBucket(candidate)
    except ValueError:
        return TimingBucket.IGNORE if allow_ignore else None
    if not allow_ignore and timing == TimingBucket.IGNORE:
        return None
    return timing


def _parse_meal_period(value: Any) -> MealPeriod | None:
    if value in (None, "", "null"):
        return None
    try:
        return MealPeriod(str(value).upper())
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _parse_date(value: Any) -> date | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    raw = str(value)
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(raw)
    except ValueError:
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(raw).date()
        except ValueError:
            return None


def _infer_missing_start_date(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    raw_item: dict[str, Any],
    reference_date: date,
) -> date | None:
    context = "\n".join(
        part
        for part in (
            str(raw_item.get("title") or ""),
            str(raw_item.get("summary") or ""),
            str(raw_item.get("notes") or ""),
            package.message_text,
            *package.thread_texts,
        )
        if part
    )
    if not context:
        return None
    return _infer_date_from_text_context(context, reference_date=reference_date)


def _infer_date_from_text_context(text: str, *, reference_date: date) -> date | None:
    lowered = text.lower()
    if "today" in lowered or "tonight" in lowered:
        return reference_date
    if "tomorrow" in lowered:
        return reference_date + timedelta(days=1)

    month_day = re.search(
        r"(january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december)\s+\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?(?:,\s*\d{4})?",
        lowered,
    )
    if month_day:
        parsed = _parse_partial_date(month_day.group(0), reference_date=reference_date)
        if parsed is not None:
            return parsed

    if "this weekend" in lowered:
        return reference_date + timedelta(days=max(5 - reference_date.weekday(), 0))
    if "this week" in lowered:
        return reference_date
    return None


def _detect_explicit_meal_period(text: str) -> MealPeriod | None:
    normalized = str(text or "").lower()
    if not normalized:
        return None

    matches: list[MealPeriod] = []
    for meal_period, phrases in _MEAL_PERIOD_PATTERNS:
        if any(
            re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(phrase)}\b", normalized) for phrase in phrases
        ):
            matches.append(meal_period)

    unique_matches = []
    seen = set()
    for match in matches:
        if match not in seen:
            unique_matches.append(match)
            seen.add(match)

    if len(unique_matches) != 1:
        return None
    return unique_matches[0]


def _parse_partial_date(raw: str, *, reference_date: date) -> date | None:
    try:
        default = datetime(reference_date.year, 1, 1)
        return dateutil_parser.parse(raw, default=default).date()
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        return None


def _normalize_location_and_address(*, location: str, address: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    location = location.strip()
    address = address.strip()
    if address:
        return location, address
    if not location:
        return "", ""
    split = _split_combined_location_address(location)
    if split is None:
        return location, ""
    return split


def _split_combined_location_address(value: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    parts = [
        part.strip(" ,") for part in re.split(r"\s+-\s+", value) if part.strip(" ,")
    ]
    if len(parts) < 2:
        return None
    address_start = next(
        (index for index, part in enumerate(parts) if re.search(r"\d", part)), None
    )
    if address_start is None or address_start == 0:
        return None
    venue = " - ".join(parts[:address_start]).strip(" ,")
    address = ", ".join(parts[address_start:]).strip(" ,")
    if not venue or not address:
        return None
    return venue, address


def _infer_recurring_start_date(
    *,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    recurrence_days: str,
    reference_date: date,
) -> date | None:
    if recurrence_pattern == "DAILY":
        return reference_date
    weekday = _weekday_from_days(recurrence_days)
    if weekday is None:
        return reference_date
    delta = (weekday - reference_date.weekday()) % 7
    return reference_date + timedelta(days=delta)


def _model_prefers_openai(model: str) -> bool:
    return model.startswith(("gpt", "o1", "o3", "o4"))


def _weekday_from_days(recurrence_days: str) -> int | None:
    if not recurrence_days:
        return None
    try:
        return int(recurrence_days.split(",")[0])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _build_item_external_id(
    *,
    package_key: str,
    file_id: str,
    title: str,
    start_date: date | None,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    recurrence_days: str,
    fallback_index: int,
) -> str:
    file_token = file_id or f"item-{fallback_index + 1}"
    title_token = _slug_token(title) or f"item-{fallback_index + 1}"
    discriminator = ""
    if recurrence_pattern != "NONE":
        recurrence_token = recurrence_pattern.lower()
        if recurrence_days:
            recurrence_token = f"{recurrence_token}-{recurrence_days.replace(',', '-')}"
        discriminator = recurrence_token
    elif start_date is not None:
        discriminator = start_date.isoformat()
    else:
        discriminator = f"item-{fallback_index + 1}"
    return f"{package_key}:{file_token}:{title_token}:{discriminator}"


def _expand_non_recurring_food_date_ranges(
    items: list[NormalizedItem],
) -> list[NormalizedItem]:
    expanded: list[NormalizedItem] = []
    for item in items:
        if (
            item.content_type != ContentType.FOOD
            or item.recurrence_pattern != "NONE"
            or item.start_date is None
            or item.end_date is None
            or item.end_date <= item.start_date
        ):
            expanded.append(item)
            continue

        file_id = item.image_file_ids[0] if item.image_file_ids else ""
        current = item.start_date
        while current <= item.end_date:
            expanded.append(
                replace(
                    item,
                    external_id=_build_item_external_id(
                        package_key=item.package_key,
                        file_id=file_id,
                        title=item.title,
                        start_date=current,
                        recurrence_pattern=item.recurrence_pattern,
                        recurrence_days=item.recurrence_days,
                        fallback_index=0,
                    ),
                    start_date=current,
                    end_date=current,
                )
            )
            current += timedelta(days=1)
    return expanded


def _collapse_food_items(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    items: list[NormalizedItem],
    reference_date: date,
) -> list[NormalizedItem]:
    grouped_by_file: dict[tuple[str, str], list[NormalizedItem]] = {}
    for item in items:
        if (
            item.content_type == ContentType.FOOD
            and len(item.image_file_ids) == 1
            and item.image_file_ids[0]
        ):
            group_key = (item.image_file_ids[0], _food_collapse_key(item))
            grouped_by_file.setdefault(group_key, []).append(item)

    attachments_by_id = {
        attachment.file_id: attachment for attachment in package.attachments
    }
    collapsed: list[NormalizedItem] = []
    handled_group_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for item in items:
        file_id = item.image_file_ids[0] if item.image_file_ids else ""
        group_key = (file_id, _food_collapse_key(item))
        grouped_items = grouped_by_file.get(group_key) or []
        if len(grouped_items) <= 1:
            collapsed.append(item)
            continue
        if group_key in handled_group_keys:
            continue
        collapsed.append(
            _merge_food_items_for_attachment(
                package=package,
                attachment=attachments_by_id.get(file_id),
                items=grouped_items,
                reference_date=reference_date,
            )
        )
        handled_group_keys.add(group_key)

    return collapsed


def _food_collapse_key(item: NormalizedItem) -> str:
    if item.recurrence_pattern != "NONE":
        end_date = (
            item.recurrence_end_date.isoformat() if item.recurrence_end_date else ""
        )
        return f"recurring:{item.recurrence_pattern}:{item.recurrence_days}:{end_date}"
    if item.start_date is not None:
        return item.start_date.isoformat()
    return "undated"


def _merge_food_items_for_attachment(
    *,
    package: SlackMessagePackage,
    attachment,
    items: list[NormalizedItem],
    reference_date: date,
) -> NormalizedItem:
    ordered_items = list(items)
    location = next((item.location for item in ordered_items if item.location), "")
    address = next((item.address for item in ordered_items if item.address), "")
    title = _collapsed_food_title(
        attachment=attachment,
        items=ordered_items,
        location=location,
    )
    start_date = min(
        (item.start_date for item in ordered_items if item.start_date is not None),
        default=None,
    )
    end_date = max(
        (
            item.end_date or item.start_date
            for item in ordered_items
            if (item.end_date or item.start_date) is not None
        ),
        default=start_date,
    )

    recurrence_pattern = "NONE"
    recurrence_days = ""
    recurrence_end_date = None
    meal_periods = {
        item.meal_period for item in ordered_items if item.meal_period is not None
    }
    meal_period = next(iter(meal_periods)) if len(meal_periods) == 1 else None
    if all(item.recurrence_pattern != "NONE" for item in ordered_items):
        unique_patterns = {item.recurrence_pattern for item in ordered_items}
        unique_days = {item.recurrence_days for item in ordered_items}
        unique_end_dates = {item.recurrence_end_date for item in ordered_items}
        if len(unique_patterns) == len(unique_days) == len(unique_end_dates) == 1:
            recurrence_pattern = ordered_items[0].recurrence_pattern
            recurrence_days = ordered_items[0].recurrence_days
            recurrence_end_date = ordered_items[0].recurrence_end_date
            if start_date is None:
                start_date = ordered_items[0].start_date
            if end_date is None:
                end_date = ordered_items[0].end_date or ordered_items[0].start_date

    timing = _collapsed_food_timing(
        items=ordered_items,
        start_date=start_date,
        recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
        reference_date=reference_date,
    )
    summary = _collapsed_food_summary(ordered_items)
    image_file_ids = list(
        dict.fromkeys(
            file_id for item in ordered_items for file_id in item.image_file_ids
        )
    )

    return NormalizedItem(
        package_key=package.package_key,
        external_id=_build_item_external_id(
            package_key=package.package_key,
            file_id=image_file_ids[0]
            if image_file_ids

            title=title,
            start_date=start_date,
            recurrence_pattern=recurrence_pattern,
            recurrence_days=recurrence_days,
            fallback_index=0,
        ),
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        content_type=ContentType.FOOD,
        timing=timing,

        end_date=end_date,

        notes=f"collapsed {len(ordered_items)} food entries from one image",
    )


def _collapsed_food_title(
    *, attachment, items: list[NormalizedItem], location: str
) -> str:
    attachment_title = str(getattr(attachment, "title", "") or "").strip()
    meal_periods = {item.meal_period for item in items if item.meal_period is not None}
    meal_period = next(iter(meal_periods)) if len(meal_periods) == 1 else None
    candidate_title = attachment_title or items[0].title
    return _normalize_food_title(
        raw_title=candidate_title,
        location=location,
        meal_period=meal_period,
    )


def _looks_like_generic_attachment_title(value: str) -> bool:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip()
    if not normalized:
        return False
    return bool(_GENERIC_ATTACHMENT_TITLE_RE.fullmatch(normalized))


def _normalize_food_title(
    *,
    raw_title: str,
    location: str,
    meal_period: MealPeriod | None,
) -> str:
    candidate = str(raw_title or "").strip()
    if candidate and _is_confident_food_title(candidate, location=location):
        return candidate
    return (
        _safe_food_title(location=location, meal_period=meal_period)
        or candidate
        or "Food Specials"
    )


def _is_confident_food_title(title: str, *, location: str) -> bool:
    normalized = str(title or "").strip()
    if not normalized:
        return False
    if _looks_like_generic_attachment_title(normalized):
        return False
    lowered = normalized.lower()
    if any(phrase in lowered for phrase in _FOOD_TITLE_CONFIDENT_PHRASES):
        return True
    if any(day in lowered for day in _WEEKDAY_TO_INDEX):
        return True
    if location and _location_tokens_overlap(title=lowered, location=location.lower()):
        return True
    return False


def _safe_food_title(*, location: str, meal_period: MealPeriod | None) -> str:
    if not location:
        return ""
    if meal_period is not None:
        label = meal_period.value.replace("_", " ").title()
        return f"{location} {label} Specials"
    return f"{location} Specials"


def _location_tokens_overlap(*, title: str, location: str) -> bool:
    title_tokens = {
        token for token in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9']+", title) if len(token) > 2
    }
    location_tokens = {
        token for token in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9']+", location) if len(token) > 2
    }
    if not title_tokens or not location_tokens:
        return False
    overlap = title_tokens & location_tokens
    return len(overlap) >= min(2, len(location_tokens))


def _collapsed_food_summary(items: list[NormalizedItem]) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in items:
        line = _collapsed_food_item_line(item)
        signature = _food_summary_signature(line)
        if line and signature not in seen:
            lines.append(line)
            seen.add(signature)
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _collapsed_food_item_line(item: NormalizedItem) -> str:

    if not summary:
        return label
    if not label:
        return summary

    lowered_summary = summary.lower()
    lowered_label = label.lower()
    if lowered_summary == lowered_label:
        return label
    if lowered_summary.startswith(f"{lowered_label}:"):
        return summary
    if lowered_summary.startswith(f"{lowered_label} "):
        remainder = summary[len(label) :].strip()
        if not remainder:
            return label
        if remainder.startswith("("):
            return f"{label} {remainder}"
        return f"{label}: {remainder}"

def _collapsed_food_item_label(item: NormalizedItem) -> str:

def _collapse_food_item_summary_text(summary: str, *, location: str) -> str:
    fragments = [

            _clean_food_summary_fragment(piece), location=location
        )
        for piece in str(summary or "").splitlines()
        if _clean_food_summary_fragment(piece)
    ]
    if not fragments:
        return _strip_location_special_prefix(
            _clean_food_summary_fragment(summary),
            location=location,
        )

    merged: str = ""
    for fragment in fragments:
        if not fragment:
            continue
        if not merged:
            merged = fragment
            continue
        merged = _merge_food_item_summary_fragment(merged, fragment)
    return merged

    cleaned = _clean_food_summary_fragment(value)
    if not cleaned or not location:
        return cleaned
    pattern = re.compile(
        rf"^{re.escape(location.strip())}(?:\s+(?:breakfast|brunch|lunch|dinner|daily|food))?\s+specials?:\s*",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    stripped = pattern.sub("", cleaned, count=1).strip()
    return stripped or cleaned

def _merge_food_item_summary_fragment(current: str, continuation: str) -> str:
    lowered = continuation.lower().strip()
    if lowered.startswith(("(", "or ")) or _FOOD_ITEM_TIME_CONTINUATION_RE.match(
        lowered
    ):
        return f"{current} {continuation}".strip()
    if continuation[:1].islower():
        return f"{current}, {continuation}".strip()
    if lowered.startswith(
        (
            "available from ",
            "bowl",
            "cup",
            "full ",
            "half ",
            "half-",
            "over ",
            "pint ",
            "quart ",
        )
    ):
        return f"{current} / {continuation}".strip()
    return f"{current} {continuation}".strip()


def _normalize_food_summary_text(value: str) -> str:
    fragments = _extract_food_summary_fragments(value)
    if not fragments:
        return _clean_food_summary_fragment(value)
    return "\n".join(fragments)


def _normalize_safe_food_summary_text(value: str) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for piece in str(value or "").replace("\r", "\n").splitlines():
        cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", piece).strip()
        if not cleaned:
            continue
        signature = _food_summary_signature(cleaned)
        if signature in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(signature)
        lines.append(cleaned)
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _merge_public_food_summary_and_note(summary: str, note: str) -> str:
    cleaned_summary = str(summary or "").strip()
    cleaned_note = _clean_food_summary_fragment(note)
    if not cleaned_note or not _looks_like_customer_facing_food_note(cleaned_note):
        return cleaned_summary
    if cleaned_summary and cleaned_note.lower() in cleaned_summary.lower():
        return cleaned_summary
    if not cleaned_summary:
        return cleaned_note
    return f"{cleaned_summary}\n{cleaned_note}"


def _looks_like_customer_facing_food_note(value: str) -> bool:
    cleaned = _clean_food_summary_fragment(value)
    if not cleaned:
        return False
    if _DIAGNOSTIC_FOOD_NOTE_RE.search(cleaned) and not _PUBLIC_PROMO_PRICE_RE.search(
        cleaned
    ):
        return False
    lowered = cleaned.lower()
    if _PUBLIC_PROMO_PRICE_RE.search(cleaned):
        return True
    return any(keyword in lowered for keyword in _PUBLIC_PROMO_KEYWORDS)


def _extract_food_summary_fragments(value: str) -> list[str]:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip()
    if not normalized:
        return []
    normalized = (
        normalized.replace("\r", "\n")
        .replace("•", "\n")
        .replace("·", "\n")
        .replace(";", "\n")
    )
    normalized = re.sub(
        r"(?<!^)\s+(?=(?:Soup:|Blue Plate:|Dessert:|App(?:s)?:))",
        "\n",
        normalized,
    )
    fragments: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for piece in normalized.splitlines():
        cleaned_piece = _clean_food_summary_fragment(piece)
        if not cleaned_piece:
            continue
        for fragment in _split_food_summary_fragment_by_price(cleaned_piece):
            signature = _food_summary_signature(fragment)
            if fragment and signature not in seen:
                fragments.append(fragment)
                seen.add(signature)
    return fragments


def _split_food_summary_fragment_by_price(fragment: str) -> list[str]:
    matches = list(_FOOD_SUMMARY_PRICE_RE.finditer(fragment))
    if len(matches) < 2:
        return [fragment]

    segments: list[str] = []
    cursor = 0
    for match in matches:
        candidate = _clean_food_summary_fragment(fragment[cursor : match.end()])
        if candidate:
            segments.append(candidate)
        cursor = match.end()

    tail = _clean_food_summary_fragment(fragment[cursor:])
    if tail:
        if segments and len(tail.split()) <= 5:
            segments[-1] = _clean_food_summary_fragment(f"{segments[-1]} {tail}")
        else:
            segments.append(tail)
    return segments


def _clean_food_summary_fragment(value: str) -> str:
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value or "")).strip(" \t,-")
    if not cleaned:
        return ""
    if _FOOD_LIST_MARKER_ONLY_RE.fullmatch(cleaned):
        return ""
    cleaned = _FOOD_LEADING_LIST_MARKER_RE.sub("", cleaned).strip()
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cleaned).strip(" \t,-")
    if _FOOD_LIST_MARKER_ONLY_RE.fullmatch(cleaned):
        return ""
    return cleaned


def _food_summary_signature(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", value.lower())


def _collapsed_food_timing(
    *,
    items: list[NormalizedItem],
    start_date: date | None,
    recurrence_pattern: str,
    reference_date: date,
) -> TimingBucket:
    if recurrence_pattern != "NONE":
        return TimingBucket.RECURRING
    if start_date is None:
        return items[0].timing
    end_of_week = reference_date + timedelta(days=(6 - reference_date.weekday()))
    if start_date <= end_of_week:
        return TimingBucket.THIS_WEEK
    return TimingBucket.LATER


def _slug_token(value: str) -> str:
    normalized = (
        unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    )
    token = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", normalized.lower()).strip("-")
    return token[:80]
