    quality_gate = _package_quality_gate(package)
    reasons = (
        quality_gate.get("heuristic_reasons") or quality_gate.get("judge_reasons") or []
    )
    reason_text = ", ".join(str(reason) for reason in reasons if str(reason).strip())
    if not reason_text:
        reason_text = "quality_gate_blocked"
    return f"quality_gate blocked: {reason_text}"


def _blocked_package_preview(package: StoredPackage) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "package_key": package.package.package_key,
        "reasons": list(_package_quality_gate(package).get("heuristic_reasons") or []),
        "repair_mode": str(_package_quality_gate(package).get("repair_mode") or ""),
        "notes": str(_package_quality_gate(package).get("notes") or ""),
    }


_VENUE_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")

#: Same venue blocked this many consecutive packages -> alert once.
VENUE_BLOCK_ALERT_THRESHOLD = 3


def _venue_tokens(package: StoredPackage) -> list[str]:
    tokens: list[str] = []
    for item in package.analyzed.items:
        raw = str(item.location or item.title or "").lower()
        token = _VENUE_TOKEN_RE.sub("-", raw).strip("-")
        if token and token not in tokens:
            tokens.append(token)
    return tokens


class RunnerState(TypedDict, total=False):
    region_key: str
    now: datetime
    dry_run: bool
    log_only: bool
    newsletter_only: bool
    skip_backend: bool
    rebuild_newsletter_today: bool
    since: datetime
    until: datetime | None
    persist_state: bool
    publish_newsletter: bool
    replace_existing_attachment_events: bool
    run_id: str
    region: Any
    fetched_packages: list[Any]
    new_packages: list[StoredPackage]
    preview_packages: list[StoredPackage]
    analysis_preview: list[dict[str, Any]]
    beehiiv: dict[str, Any]
    backend: dict[str, Any]


class SpecialIngestRunner:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        config: AppConfig,
        state: SqliteStateStore,
        slack_client=None,
        source_clients=None,
        analyzer,
        beehiiv_client,
        backend_client,
        alert_sink=None,
    ):
        self.config = config
        self.state = state
        clients = list(source_clients or [])
        if not clients and slack_client is not None:
            clients.append(slack_client)
        self.source_clients = clients
        self.slack_client = slack_client
        self.analyzer = analyzer
        self.beehiiv_client = beehiiv_client
        self.backend_client = backend_client
        self.alert_sink = alert_sink
        self._graph = self._build_graph()

    def _record_blocked_package_venues(
        self,
        *,
        region_key: str,
        package: StoredPackage,
        now: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Track consecutive quality-gate blocks per venue; alert at threshold.

        Alerting must never break a run, so all failures are swallowed.
        """
        tokens = _venue_tokens(package)
        if not tokens:
            return
        try:
            counts = self.state.record_venue_blocks(
                region_key, tokens, now=now or datetime.now(UTC)
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception(
                "Failed to record venue block stats for %s",
                package.package.package_key,
            )
            return
        for token, (consecutive, alerted) in counts.items():
            if (
                consecutive < VENUE_BLOCK_ALERT_THRESHOLD
                or alerted
                or self.alert_sink is None
            ):
                continue
            message = (
                f"Quality gate has blocked venue '{token}' in region "
                f"'{region_key}' {consecutive} consecutive times — its "
                "specials are not being published. Latest package: "
                f"{package.package.package_key} "
                f"({_blocked_package_error(package)})"
            )
            try:
                self.alert_sink(message)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                _log.exception("Failed to send venue block alert for %s", token)
                continue
            try:
                self.state.mark_venue_alerted(region_key, token)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                _log.exception("Failed to mark venue %s alerted", token)

    def _reset_uploaded_package_venues(
        self, *, region_key: str, package: StoredPackage
    ) -> None:
        try:
            self.state.reset_venue_blocks(region_key, _venue_tokens(package))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception(
                "Failed to reset venue block stats for %s",
                package.package.package_key,
            )

    def _build_graph(self):
        graph = StateGraph(RunnerState)
        graph.add_node("load_context", self._node_load_context)
        graph.add_node("fetch_packages", self._node_fetch_packages)
        graph.add_node("persist_packages", self._node_persist_packages)
        graph.add_node("publish_beehiiv", self._node_publish_beehiiv)
        graph.add_node("upload_backend", self._node_upload_backend)
        graph.add_edge(START, "load_context")
        graph.add_edge("load_context", "fetch_packages")
        graph.add_edge("fetch_packages", "persist_packages")
        graph.add_edge("persist_packages", "publish_beehiiv")
        graph.add_edge("persist_packages", "upload_backend")
        graph.add_edge("publish_beehiiv", END)
        graph.add_edge("upload_backend", END)
        return graph.compile()

    def run(
        self,
        *,
        region_key: str,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        dry_run: bool = False,
        log_only: bool = False,
        newsletter_only: bool = False,
        skip_backend: bool = False,
        rebuild_newsletter_today: bool = False,
        since: datetime | None = None,
        until: datetime | None = None,
        persist_state: bool = True,
        publish_newsletter: bool = True,
        replace_existing_attachment_events: bool = False,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        current = now or datetime.now(tz=UTC)
        start_snapshot = capture_runtime_snapshot()
        _log.info(
            "Runtime snapshot phase=start region=%s pid=%s rss_mb=%s maxrss_mb=%s threads=%s fds=%s",
            region_key,
            start_snapshot.pid,
            to_megabytes(start_snapshot.rss_bytes),
            to_megabytes(start_snapshot.max_rss_bytes),
            start_snapshot.thread_count,
            start_snapshot.fd_count,
        )
        run_id: str | None = None
        try:
            result = self._graph.invoke(
                {
                    "region_key": region_key,
                    "now": current,
                    "dry_run": dry_run,
                    "log_only": log_only,
                    "newsletter_only": newsletter_only,
                    "skip_backend": skip_backend,
                    "rebuild_newsletter_today": rebuild_newsletter_today,
                    "since": since,
                    "until": until,
                    "persist_state": persist_state,
                    "publish_newsletter": publish_newsletter,
                    "replace_existing_attachment_events": replace_existing_attachment_events,
                }
            )
            run_id = result.get("run_id")
        except Exception:
            error_snapshot = capture_runtime_snapshot()
            _log.warning(
                "Runtime snapshot phase=error region=%s run_id=%s pid=%s rss_mb=%s maxrss_mb=%s threads=%s fds=%s delta_rss_mb=%s delta_threads=%s delta_fds=%s",
                region_key,
                run_id,
                error_snapshot.pid,
                to_megabytes(error_snapshot.rss_bytes),
                to_megabytes(error_snapshot.max_rss_bytes),
                error_snapshot.thread_count,
                error_snapshot.fd_count,
                delta_megabytes(start_snapshot.rss_bytes, error_snapshot.rss_bytes),
                error_snapshot.thread_count - start_snapshot.thread_count,
                (
                    error_snapshot.fd_count - start_snapshot.fd_count
                    if error_snapshot.fd_count is not None
                    and start_snapshot.fd_count is not None
                    else None
                ),
            )
            raise
        final = {
            "run_id": result.get("run_id"),
            "since": result.get("since").isoformat() if result.get("since") else None,
            "region": region_key,
            "packages": len(result.get("fetched_packages") or []),
            "beehiiv": result.get("beehiiv") or {"created": 0, "failed": 0},
            "backend": result.get("backend") or {"uploaded": 0, "failed": 0},
            **({"analysis": result.get("analysis_preview") or []} if log_only else {}),
        }
        _log.info(
            "Run complete region=%s run_id=%s packages=%s beehiiv_created=%s beehiiv_failed=%s backend_uploaded=%s backend_failed=%s",
            region_key,
            final.get("run_id"),
            final["packages"],
            final["beehiiv"].get("created", 0),
            final["beehiiv"].get("failed", 0),
            final["backend"].get("uploaded", 0),
            final["backend"].get("failed", 0),
        )
        end_snapshot = capture_runtime_snapshot()
        _log.info(
            "Runtime snapshot phase=end region=%s run_id=%s pid=%s rss_mb=%s maxrss_mb=%s threads=%s fds=%s delta_rss_mb=%s delta_threads=%s delta_fds=%s",
            region_key,
            final.get("run_id"),
            end_snapshot.pid,
            to_megabytes(end_snapshot.rss_bytes),
            to_megabytes(end_snapshot.max_rss_bytes),
            end_snapshot.thread_count,
            end_snapshot.fd_count,
            delta_megabytes(start_snapshot.rss_bytes, end_snapshot.rss_bytes),
            end_snapshot.thread_count - start_snapshot.thread_count,
            (
                end_snapshot.fd_count - start_snapshot.fd_count
                if end_snapshot.fd_count is not None
                and start_snapshot.fd_count is not None
                else None
            ),
        )
        return final

    def _node_load_context(self, state: RunnerState) -> RunnerState:
        region = self.config.regions[state["region_key"]]
        context = {
            "region": region,
            "run_id": f"{state['region_key']}-{uuid4().hex[:8]}",
            "since": state.get("since")
            or self.state.get_since(state["region_key"], now=state["now"]),
        }
        _log.info(
            "Starting run region=%s run_id=%s dry_run=%s log_only=%s newsletter_only=%s skip_backend=%s since=%s timezone=%s",
            state["region_key"],
            context["run_id"],
            bool(state.get("dry_run")),
            bool(state.get("log_only")),
            bool(state.get("newsletter_only")),
            bool(state.get("skip_backend")),
            context["since"].isoformat(),
            region.timezone,
        )
        return context

    def _node_fetch_packages(self, state: RunnerState) -> RunnerState:
        if state.get("newsletter_only"):
            _log.info(
                "Skipping source fetch for region=%s because newsletter_only is enabled",
                state["region_key"],
            )
            return {"fetched_packages": []}
        region = state["region"]
        fetched: list[Any] = []
        for source_client in self.source_clients:
            channels = _source_channels(region=region, source_client=source_client)
            if not channels:
                continue
            source_packages = source_client.fetch_packages(
                channels=channels,
                since=state["since"],
                now=state["now"],
                timezone=region.timezone,
                until=state.get("until"),
            )
            for package in source_packages:
                package.region_key = state["region_key"]
            fetched.extend(source_packages)
        _log.info(
            "Fetched %s source packages for region=%s across %s clients",
            len(fetched),
            state["region_key"],
            len(self.source_clients),
        )
        fetched.sort(key=lambda item: float(item.message_ts))
        return {"fetched_packages": fetched}

    def _node_persist_packages(self, state: RunnerState) -> RunnerState:
        stored: list[StoredPackage] = []
        preview_packages: list[StoredPackage] = []
        analysis_preview: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        max_seen: datetime | None = None
        log_only = bool(state.get("log_only"))
        persist_state = bool(state.get("persist_state", True))
        reference_date = (
            state["now"].astimezone(ZoneInfo(state["region"].timezone)).date()
        )
        _set_analyzer_reference_date(self.analyzer, reference_date)
        seen_dedupe_keys = {
            dedupe_key
            for package in self.state.list_packages_for_local_day(
                state["region_key"],
                day=reference_date,
                timezone=state["region"].timezone,
            )
            if (dedupe_key := _package_dedupe_key(package.package))
        }
        for package in state.get("fetched_packages") or []:
            package_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(float(package.message_ts), tz=UTC)
            if max_seen is None or package_dt > max_seen:
                # Advance the checkpoint even when we skip analysis so a restart
                # cannot replay the same source package indefinitely.
                max_seen = package_dt
            if (
                not log_only
                and persist_state
                and self.state.has_package(package.package_key)
            ):
                _log.info(
                    "Skipping previously stored source package region=%s package=%s",
                    state["region_key"],
                    package.package_key,
                )
                continue
            dedupe_key = _package_dedupe_key(package)
            if dedupe_key and dedupe_key in seen_dedupe_keys:
                _log.info(
                    "Skipping duplicate source package region=%s package=%s",
                    state["region_key"],
                    package.package_key,
                )
                continue
            analyzed = self.analyzer.analyze_package(package)
            _log.debug(
                "Analyzed package=%s attachments=%s thread_replies=%s items=%s",
                package.package_key,
                len(package.attachments),
                len(package.thread_texts),
                len(analyzed.items),
            )
            analysis_preview.append(
                {
                    "package_key": package.package_key,
                    "message_text": package.message_text,
                    "thread_texts": list(package.thread_texts),
                    "attachments": [
                        attachment.file_id for attachment in package.attachments
                    ],
                    "image_classifications": [
                        dataclass_to_jsonable(item)
                        for item in analyzed.image_classifications
                    ],
                    "items": [dataclass_to_jsonable(item) for item in analyzed.items],
                    "agent_output": analyzed.debug,
                }
            )

            preview_package = self._build_stored_package(
                region_key=state["region_key"],
                run_id=state["run_id"],
                package=package,
                analyzed=analyzed,
            )
            if dedupe_key:
                seen_dedupe_keys.add(dedupe_key)
            preview_packages.append(preview_package)

            if (
                not log_only
                and persist_state
                and self.state.store_analyzed_package(
                    region_key=state["region_key"],
                    run_id=state["run_id"],
                    package=package,
                    analyzed=analyzed,
                )
            ):
                stored.append(preview_package)
                if _is_blocked_package(preview_package):
                    error = _blocked_package_error(preview_package)
                    self.state.mark_beehiiv_blocked(
                        [preview_package.package.package_key],
                        error=error,
                    )
                    self.state.mark_backend_blocked(
                        preview_package.package.package_key,
                        error=error,
                    )
                    self._record_blocked_package_venues(
                        region_key=state["region_key"],
                        package=preview_package,
                        now=state.get("now"),
                    )

        if not log_only and persist_state and max_seen is not None:
            self.state.set_checkpoint(state["region_key"], max_seen)
        if log_only or not persist_state:
            _log.info(
                "Prepared %s preview packages for region=%s without persisting state",
                len(preview_packages),
                state["region_key"],
            )
        else:
            _log.info(
                "Persisted %s new packages for region=%s checkpoint=%s",
                len(stored),
                state["region_key"],
                max_seen.isoformat() if max_seen else None,
            )
        return {
            "new_packages": stored,
            "preview_packages": preview_packages,
            "analysis_preview": analysis_preview,
        }

    def _node_publish_beehiiv(self, state: RunnerState) -> RunnerState:
        if not state.get("publish_newsletter", True):
            _log.info(
                "Skipping newsletter publish for region=%s because publish_newsletter is disabled",
                state["region_key"],
            )
            return {"beehiiv": {"created": 0, "failed": 0, "skipped": 1}}
        blocked_packages: list[StoredPackage] = [
            package
            for package in (state.get("new_packages") or [])
            if _is_blocked_package(package)
        ]
        if state.get("log_only"):
            candidate_packages = state.get("preview_packages") or []
            pending_run_id = state["run_id"]
        elif state.get("rebuild_newsletter_today"):
            local_day = (
                state["now"].astimezone(ZoneInfo(state["region"].timezone)).date()
            )
            candidate_packages = self.state.list_packages_for_local_day(
                state["region_key"],
                day=local_day,
                timezone=state["region"].timezone,
            )
            pending_run_id = state["run_id"]
            if not candidate_packages:
                _log.info(
                    "No newsletter packages available for region=%s local_day=%s",
                    state["region_key"],
                    local_day.isoformat(),
                )
                return {"beehiiv": {"created": 0, "failed": 0}}
        else:
            candidate_packages = self.state.list_pending_beehiiv_packages(
                state["region_key"]
            )
            if not candidate_packages:
                if blocked_packages:
                    _log.info(
                        "No pending Beehiiv work for region=%s after excluding blocked packages",
                        state["region_key"],
                    )
                    return {
                        "beehiiv": {
                            "created": 0,
                            "failed": 0,
                            "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                            "blocked_packages": [
                                _blocked_package_preview(package)
                                for package in blocked_packages
                            ],
                        }
                    }
                _log.info("No pending Beehiiv work for region=%s", state["region_key"])
                return {"beehiiv": {"created": 0, "failed": 0}}
            blocked_pending_packages = [
                package
                for package in candidate_packages
                if _is_blocked_package(package)
            ]
            if state.get("persist_state", True):
                for package in blocked_pending_packages:
                    self.state.mark_beehiiv_blocked(
                        [package.package.package_key],
                        error=_blocked_package_error(package),
                    )
            publishable_candidates = [
                package
                for package in candidate_packages
                if not _is_blocked_package(package)
            ]
            if not publishable_candidates:
                _log.info(
                    "No publishable Beehiiv work for region=%s after quality gate filtering",
                    state["region_key"],
                )
                return {
                    "beehiiv": {
                        "created": 0,
                        "failed": 0,
                        "blocked": len(blocked_pending_packages),
                        "blocked_packages": [
                            _blocked_package_preview(package)
                            for package in blocked_pending_packages
                        ],
                    }
                }
            pending_run_id = publishable_candidates[0].run_id
            candidate_packages = [
                package
                for package in publishable_candidates
                if package.run_id == pending_run_id
            ]
        if not blocked_packages:
            blocked_packages = [
                package
                for package in candidate_packages
                if _is_blocked_package(package)
            ]
        packages = [
            package
            for package in candidate_packages
            if not _is_blocked_package(package)
        ]
        if not packages:
            return {
                "beehiiv": {
                    "created": 0,
                    "failed": 0,
                    "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                    "blocked_packages": [
                        _blocked_package_preview(package)
                        for package in blocked_packages
                    ],
                }
            }
        items = [item for package in packages for item in package.analyzed.items]
        if not items:
            _log.info(
                "No Beehiiv items to publish for region=%s run_id=%s",
                state["region_key"],
                pending_run_id,
            )
            return {
                "beehiiv": {
                    "created": 0,
                    "failed": 0,
                    "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                    "blocked_packages": [
                        _blocked_package_preview(package)
                        for package in blocked_packages
                    ],
                }
            }
        if state.get("log_only"):
            preview = (
                self.beehiiv_client.build_draft_preview(
                    region=state["region"],
                    run_id=pending_run_id,
                    items=items,
                    now=state["now"],
                )
                if hasattr(self.beehiiv_client, "build_draft_preview")
                else {
                    "payload": self.beehiiv_client.build_draft_payload(
                        region=state["region"],
                        run_id=pending_run_id,
                        items=items,
                        now=state["now"],
                    ),
                    "agent_output": {},
                }
            )
            _log.info(
                "Built Beehiiv preview payload for region=%s run_id=%s items=%s",
                state["region_key"],
                pending_run_id,
                len(items),
            )
            return {
                "beehiiv": {
                    "created": 0,
                    "failed": 0,
                    "logged": 1,
                    "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                    "blocked_packages": [
                        _blocked_package_preview(package)
                        for package in blocked_packages
                    ],
                    "payload": preview["payload"],
                    "agent_output": preview.get("agent_output") or {},
                }
            }
        if state["dry_run"]:
            _log.info(
                "Skipping Beehiiv publish in dry-run mode for region=%s run_id=%s",
                state["region_key"],
                pending_run_id,
            )
            return {
                "beehiiv": {
                    "created": 1,
                    "failed": 0,
                    "draft_id": "dry-run",
                    "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                    "blocked_packages": [
                        _blocked_package_preview(package)
                        for package in blocked_packages
                    ],
                }
            }
        try:
            result = self.beehiiv_client.create_draft(
                region=state["region"],
                run_id=pending_run_id,
                items=items,
                now=state["now"],
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            error_summary = {
                "run_id": pending_run_id,
                "package_keys": [package.package.package_key for package in packages],
                "error": str(exc),
            }
            _log.exception(
                "Beehiiv publish failed region=%s run_id=%s items=%s",
                state["region_key"],
                pending_run_id,
                len(items),
            )
            self.state.mark_beehiiv_failure(
                error_summary["package_keys"],
                error=str(exc),
            )
            return {
                "beehiiv": {
                    "created": 0,
                    "failed": len(packages),
                    "errors": [error_summary],
                }
            }

        draft_id = str(result.get("id") or result.get("post_id") or "")
        _log.info(
            "Beehiiv draft created region=%s run_id=%s draft_id=%s items=%s",
            state["region_key"],
            pending_run_id,
            draft_id,
            len(items),
        )
        self.state.mark_beehiiv_success(
            [package.package.package_key for package in packages],
            draft_id=draft_id,
        )
        return {
            "beehiiv": {
                "created": 1,
                "failed": 0,
                "draft_id": draft_id,
                **({"draft_url": str(result["url"])} if result.get("url") else {}),
                **({"action": str(result["action"])} if result.get("action") else {}),
                "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                "blocked_packages": [
                    _blocked_package_preview(package) for package in blocked_packages
                ],
            }
        }

    def _node_upload_backend(self, state: RunnerState) -> RunnerState:
        if state.get("newsletter_only") or state.get("skip_backend"):
            _log.info(
                "Skipping backend upload for region=%s because newsletter_only=%s skip_backend=%s",
                state["region_key"],
                bool(state.get("newsletter_only")),
                bool(state.get("skip_backend")),
            )
            return {"backend": {"uploaded": 0, "failed": 0, "skipped": 1}}
        if state.get("log_only"):
            pending_packages = state.get("preview_packages") or []
        elif not state.get("persist_state", True):
            pending_packages = state.get("preview_packages") or []
        else:
            pending_packages = self.state.list_pending_backend_packages(
                state["region_key"]
            )
        if not pending_packages:
            blocked_packages = [
                package
                for package in (state.get("new_packages") or [])
                if _is_blocked_package(package)
            ]
            if blocked_packages:
                _log.info(
                    "No pending backend work for region=%s after excluding blocked packages",
                    state["region_key"],
                )
                return {
                    "backend": {
                        "uploaded": 0,
                        "failed": 0,
                        "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                        "blocked_packages": [
                            _blocked_package_preview(package)
                            for package in blocked_packages
                        ],
                    }
                }
            _log.info("No pending backend work for region=%s", state["region_key"])
            return {"backend": {"uploaded": 0, "failed": 0}}
        blocked_packages = [
            package for package in pending_packages if _is_blocked_package(package)
        ]

def _package_quality_gate(package: StoredPackage) -> dict[str, Any]:
    quality_gate = package.analyzed.debug.get("quality_gate") or {}
    return quality_gate if isinstance(quality_gate, dict) else {}


def _is_blocked_package(package: StoredPackage) -> bool:
    return str(_package_quality_gate(package).get("repair_mode") or "") == "BLOCK"


def _blocked_package_error(package: StoredPackage) -> str:
    quality_gate = _package_quality_gate(package)
    reasons = (
        quality_gate.get("heuristic_reasons") or quality_gate.get("judge_reasons") or []
    )
    reason_text = ", ".join(str(reason) for reason in reasons if str(reason).strip())
    if not reason_text:
        reason_text = "quality_gate_blocked"
    return f"quality_gate blocked: {reason_text}"


def _blocked_package_preview(package: StoredPackage) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "package_key": package.package.package_key,
        "reasons": list(_package_quality_gate(package).get("heuristic_reasons") or []),
        "repair_mode": str(_package_quality_gate(package).get("repair_mode") or ""),
        "notes": str(_package_quality_gate(package).get("notes") or ""),
    }


_VENUE_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")

VENUE_BLOCK_ALERT_THRESHOLD = 3


def _venue_tokens(package: StoredPackage) -> list[str]:
    tokens: list[str] = []
    for item in package.analyzed.items:
        raw = str(item.location or item.title or "").lower()
        token = _VENUE_TOKEN_RE.sub("-", raw).strip("-")
        if token and token not in tokens:
            tokens.append(token)
    return tokens

                channels=channels,

                now=state["now"],
                timezone=region.timezone,
                until=state.get("until"),

                package.region_key = state["region_key"]

            "Fetched %s source packages for region=%s across %s clients",
            len(fetched),

    def _node_upload_backend(self, state: RunnerState) -> RunnerState:
        if state.get("newsletter_only") or state.get("skip_backend"):
            _log.info(
                "Skipping backend upload for region=%s because newsletter_only=%s skip_backend=%s",
                state["region_key"],
                bool(state.get("newsletter_only")),
                bool(state.get("skip_backend")),
            )
            return {"backend": {"uploaded": 0, "failed": 0, "skipped": 1}}
        if state.get("log_only"):
            pending_packages = state.get("preview_packages") or []
        elif not state.get("persist_state", True):
            pending_packages = state.get("preview_packages") or []
        else:
            pending_packages = self.state.list_pending_backend_packages(
                state["region_key"]
            )
        if not pending_packages:
            blocked_packages = [
                package
                for package in (state.get("new_packages") or [])
                if _is_blocked_package(package)
            ]
            if blocked_packages:
                _log.info(
                    "No pending backend work for region=%s after excluding blocked packages",
                    state["region_key"],
                )
                return {
                    "backend": {
                        "uploaded": 0,
                        "failed": 0,
                        "blocked": len(blocked_packages),
                        "blocked_packages": [
                            _blocked_package_preview(package)
                            for package in blocked_packages
                        ],
                    }
                }
            _log.info("No pending backend work for region=%s", state["region_key"])
            return {"backend": {"uploaded": 0, "failed": 0}}
        blocked_packages = [
            package for package in pending_packages if _is_blocked_package(package)
        ]
        if state.get("persist_state", True):
            for package in blocked_packages:
                self.state.mark_backend_blocked(
                    package.package.package_key,
                    error=_blocked_package_error(package),
                )
                self._record_blocked_package_venues(
                    region_key=state["region_key"],
                    package=package,
                    now=state.get("now"),
                )
        publishable_packages = [
            package for package in pending_packages if not _is_blocked_package(package)
        ]
        if state.get("log_only"):
            _log.info(
                "Built %s backend preview payloads for region=%s",
                len(publishable_packages),
                state["region_key"],

            return {

                            ),
                        )
                        for package in publishable_packages
                    ],
                }
            }

        uploaded = 0
        failed = 0
        errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        for package in publishable_packages:
            if state["dry_run"]:
                uploaded += 1
                continue
            try:
                metadata = self.backend_client.upload_items(
                    region=state["region"],
                    items=package.analyzed.items,
                    source_package=package.package,
                    replace_existing_attachment_events=bool(
                        state.get("replace_existing_attachment_events")
                    ),
                )
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                failed += 1
                error_summary = {
                    "package_key": package.package.package_key,
                    "error": str(exc),
                }
                errors.append(error_summary)
                _log.exception(
                    "Backend upload failed region=%s package=%s items=%s",
                    state["region_key"],
                    package.package.package_key,
                    len(package.analyzed.items),
                )
                if state.get("persist_state", True):
                    self.state.mark_backend_failure(
                        package.package.package_key, error=str(exc)
                    )
                continue
            uploaded += 1
            _log.info(
                "Backend upload succeeded region=%s package=%s items=%s",
                state["region_key"],
                package.package.package_key,
                len(package.analyzed.items),
            )
            if state.get("persist_state", True):
                self.state.mark_backend_success(

                "blocked_packages": [

def build_runner(app_config):
    region = next(iter(app_config.regions.values()))
    state = SqliteStateStore(region.state_db_path or f"{region.key}.state.sqlite3")
    state.initialize()
    newsletter_composer = build_default_newsletter_composer(region)
    if region.beehiiv.delivery_mode == "slack_file":
        newsletter_client = SlackNewsletterFileClient(
            bot_token=region.slack.resolved_bot_token(),
            channel_id=region.slack.resolved_output_channel(),
            composer=newsletter_composer,
            state_store=state,
        )
    elif region.beehiiv.delivery_mode == "google_doc":
        newsletter_client = GoogleDocNewsletterClient(
            composer=newsletter_composer,
            state_store=state,
        )
    else:
        newsletter_client = BeehiivDraftClient(composer=newsletter_composer, state_store=state)
    source_clients = []
    if region.slack is not None:
        source_clients.append(SlackPollingClient(bot_token=region.slack.resolved_bot_token()))
    discord_runtime = None
    if region.discord is not None:
        discord_runtime = DiscordBotRuntime(
            region_key=region.key,
            discord_config=region.discord,
            runner=None,
        )
        source_clients.append(DiscordPollingClient(runtime=discord_runtime))
    runner = SpecialIngestRunner(
        config=app_config,
        state=state,
        source_clients=source_clients,
        analyzer=build_default_analyzer(region),
        beehiiv_client=newsletter_client,
        backend_client=BackendIngestClient(),
    )
    if discord_runtime is not None:
        discord_runtime.runner = runner
    return runner


def _parse_since(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value).astimezone(UTC)


def _parse_until(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value).astimezone(UTC)


def _resolve_region_key(app_config: AppConfig, region_key: str | None) -> str:
    if region_key:
        if region_key not in app_config.regions:
            raise KeyError(region_key)
        return region_key
    if len(app_config.regions) == 1:
        return next(iter(app_config.regions))
    raise KeyError("region")


class TriggerHTTPServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    allow_reuse_address = True
    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        host: str,
        port: int,
        region_key: str,
        app_config: AppConfig,
        runner,
        trigger_token: str | None,
        dry_run_default: bool,
        log_only_default: bool,
        newsletter_only_default: bool = False,
        poll_interval_seconds: int = DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
        slack_response_sender=None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__((host, port), TriggerRequestHandler)
        self.region_key = region_key
        self.app_config = app_config
        self.runner = runner
        self.trigger_token = trigger_token
        self.dry_run_default = dry_run_default
        self.log_only_default = log_only_default
        self.newsletter_only_default = newsletter_only_default
        self.poll_interval_seconds = max(0, poll_interval_seconds)
        self.run_lock = Lock()
        self._stop_event = Event()
        self._poll_thread: Thread | None = None
        self.slack_response_sender = slack_response_sender or _post_slack_command_response

    def execute_run(
        self,
        *,
        dry_run: bool,
        log_only: bool,
        newsletter_only: bool,
        skip_backend: bool = False,
        rebuild_newsletter_today: bool = False,
        since: datetime | None,
        source: str,
        remote: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict | None:
        try:
            validate_runtime_requirements(
                self.app_config,
                region_key=self.region_key,
                dry_run=dry_run,
                log_only=log_only,
                newsletter_only=newsletter_only,
                skip_backend=skip_backend,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            _log.error("%s rejected region=%s error=%s", source, self.region_key, exc)
            raise

        _log.info(
            "%s region=%s dry_run=%s log_only=%s newsletter_only=%s skip_backend=%s since=%s remote=%s",
            source,
            self.region_key,
            dry_run,
            log_only,
            newsletter_only,
            skip_backend,
            since.isoformat() if since else None,
            remote,
        )
        result = self.runner.run(
            region_key=self.region_key,
            dry_run=dry_run,
            log_only=log_only,
            newsletter_only=newsletter_only,
            skip_backend=skip_backend,
            rebuild_newsletter_today=rebuild_newsletter_today,
            since=since,
        )
        _log.info(
            "%s complete region=%s run_id=%s packages=%s beehiiv=%s backend=%s",
            source,
            self.region_key,
            result.get("run_id"),
            result.get("packages"),
            result.get("beehiiv"),
            result.get("backend"),
        )
        return result

    def run_scheduled_poll_once(self) -> dict | None:
        if not self.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            _log.info(
                "Skipping scheduled poll region=%s because another run is in progress",
                self.region_key,
            )
            return None
        try:
            return self.execute_run(
                dry_run=self.dry_run_default,
                log_only=self.log_only_default,
                newsletter_only=self.newsletter_only_default,
                skip_backend=False,
                rebuild_newsletter_today=False,
                since=None,
                source="Scheduled poll",
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception("Scheduled poll failed region=%s", self.region_key)
            return None
        finally:
            self.run_lock.release()

    def start_background_polling(self) -> None:
        if self.poll_interval_seconds <= 0 or self._poll_thread is not None:
            return
        self._poll_thread = Thread(target=self._poll_loop, daemon=True, name="slack-region-poller")
        self._poll_thread.start()

    def _poll_loop(self) -> None:
        self.run_scheduled_poll_once()
        while not self._stop_event.wait(self.poll_interval_seconds):
            self.run_scheduled_poll_once()

    def server_close(self) -> None:
        self._stop_event.set()
        poll_thread = self._poll_thread
        if poll_thread is not None and poll_thread.is_alive():
            poll_thread.join(timeout=1)
        super().server_close()


class SocketModeCommandServer:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        region_key: str,
        app_config: AppConfig,
        runner,
        dry_run_default: bool,
        log_only_default: bool,
        newsletter_only_default: bool = False,
        poll_interval_seconds: int = DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
        socket_client=None,
        slack_response_sender=None,
        run_lock: Lock | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.region_key = region_key
        self.app_config = app_config
        self.runner = runner
        self.dry_run_default = dry_run_default
        self.log_only_default = log_only_default
        self.newsletter_only_default = newsletter_only_default
        self.poll_interval_seconds = max(0, poll_interval_seconds)
        self.run_lock = run_lock or Lock()
        self._stop_event = Event()
        self._poll_thread: Thread | None = None
        self.slack_response_sender = slack_response_sender or _post_slack_command_response

        region = self.app_config.regions[self.region_key]
        self.socket_client = socket_client or create_socket_mode_client(
            app_token=region.slack.resolved_app_token(),
            bot_token=region.slack.resolved_bot_token(),
            on_error_listener=self._handle_socket_mode_error,
            on_close_listener=self._handle_socket_mode_close,
            logger=_log,
        )
        if socket_client is None:
            _log.info(
                "Using Slack Socket Mode backend=websocket-client region=%s",
                self.region_key,
            )
        self.socket_client.socket_mode_request_listeners.append(
            self.handle_socket_mode_request
        )

    def execute_run(
        self,
        *,
        dry_run: bool,
        log_only: bool,
        newsletter_only: bool,
        skip_backend: bool = False,
        rebuild_newsletter_today: bool = False,
        since: datetime | None,
        source: str,
        remote: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict | None:
        try:
            validate_runtime_requirements(
                self.app_config,
                region_key=self.region_key,
                dry_run=dry_run,
                log_only=log_only,
                newsletter_only=newsletter_only,
                skip_backend=skip_backend,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            _log.error("%s rejected region=%s error=%s", source, self.region_key, exc)
            raise

        _log.info(
            "%s region=%s dry_run=%s log_only=%s newsletter_only=%s skip_backend=%s since=%s remote=%s",
            source,
            self.region_key,
            dry_run,
            log_only,
            newsletter_only,
            skip_backend,
            since.isoformat() if since else None,
            remote,
        )
        result = self.runner.run(
            region_key=self.region_key,
            dry_run=dry_run,
            log_only=log_only,
            newsletter_only=newsletter_only,
            skip_backend=skip_backend,
            rebuild_newsletter_today=rebuild_newsletter_today,
            since=since,
        )
        _log.info(
            "%s complete region=%s run_id=%s packages=%s beehiiv=%s backend=%s",
            source,
            self.region_key,
            result.get("run_id"),
            result.get("packages"),
            result.get("beehiiv"),
            result.get("backend"),
        )
        return result

    def run_scheduled_poll_once(self) -> dict | None:
        if not self.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            _log.info(
                "Skipping scheduled poll region=%s because another run is in progress",
                self.region_key,
            )
            return None
        try:
            return self.execute_run(
                dry_run=self.dry_run_default,
                log_only=self.log_only_default,
                newsletter_only=self.newsletter_only_default,
                skip_backend=False,
                rebuild_newsletter_today=False,
                since=None,
                source="Scheduled poll",
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception("Scheduled poll failed region=%s", self.region_key)
            return None
        finally:
            self.run_lock.release()

    def start_background_polling(self) -> None:
        if self.poll_interval_seconds <= 0 or self._poll_thread is not None:
            return
        self._poll_thread = Thread(target=self._poll_loop, daemon=True, name="slack-region-poller")
        self._poll_thread.start()

    def _poll_loop(self) -> None:
        self.run_scheduled_poll_once()
        while not self._stop_event.wait(self.poll_interval_seconds):
            self.run_scheduled_poll_once()

    def handle_socket_mode_request(
        self, client: Any, request: SocketModeRequest
    ) -> None:
        if request.type != "slash_commands":
            client.send_socket_mode_response(
                SocketModeResponse(envelope_id=request.envelope_id)
            )
            return

        payload = dict(request.payload or {})
        channel_id = str(payload.get("channel_id") or "")
        response_url = str(payload.get("response_url") or "")
        command_name = str(payload.get("command") or "")

        if command_name != "/newsletter":
            client.send_socket_mode_response(
                SocketModeResponse(
                    envelope_id=request.envelope_id,
                    payload={
                        "response_type": "ephemeral",
                        "text": f"Unsupported command: {command_name or 'unknown'}",
                    },
                )
            )
            return

        region = self.app_config.regions[self.region_key]
        if not _channel_is_connected(region=region, channel_id=channel_id):
            client.send_socket_mode_response(
                SocketModeResponse(
                    envelope_id=request.envelope_id,
                    payload={
                        "response_type": "ephemeral",
                        "text": "This command only works in the connected Slack channels for this region.",
                    },
                )
            )
            return

        if not self.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            client.send_socket_mode_response(
                SocketModeResponse(
                    envelope_id=request.envelope_id,
                    payload={
                        "response_type": "ephemeral",
                        "text": "A newsletter run is already in progress. Try again in a minute.",
                    },
                )
            )
            return

        client.send_socket_mode_response(
            SocketModeResponse(
                envelope_id=request.envelope_id,
                payload={
                    "response_type": "ephemeral",
                    "text": "Starting newsletter generation. I’ll post the result back here.",
                },
            )
        )
        Thread(
            target=self._run_slack_command,
            args=(response_url, channel_id),
            daemon=True,
            name="socket-command-newsletter",
        ).start()

    def _run_slack_command(self, response_url: str, channel_id: str) -> None:
        try:
            result = self.execute_run(
                dry_run=False,
                log_only=False,
                newsletter_only=False,
                skip_backend=True,
                rebuild_newsletter_today=True,
                since=None,
                source="Socket mode command",
                remote=channel_id,
            )
            payload = _build_slack_command_result_payload(
                region_key=self.region_key,
                result=result or {},
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception(
                "Socket mode command failed region=%s channel=%s",
                self.region_key,
                channel_id,
            )
            payload = {
                "response_type": "ephemeral",
                "text": f"Newsletter generation failed: {exc}",
            }
        finally:
            self.run_lock.release()

        if response_url:
            try:
                self.slack_response_sender(response_url, payload)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                _log.exception(
                    "Failed to send Socket Mode response region=%s channel=%s",
                    self.region_key,
                    channel_id,
                )

    def serve_forever(self) -> None:
        self.start_background_polling()
        self.start()
        self._stop_event.wait()

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.socket_client.connect()

    def _handle_socket_mode_error(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        error = args[-1] if args else "-"
        snapshot = capture_runtime_snapshot()
        _log.warning(
            "Socket Mode error region=%s pid=%s error=%s rss_mb=%s maxrss_mb=%s threads=%s fds=%s",
            self.region_key,
            snapshot.pid,
            error,
            to_megabytes(snapshot.rss_bytes),
            to_megabytes(snapshot.max_rss_bytes),
            snapshot.thread_count,
            snapshot.fd_count,
        )

    def _handle_socket_mode_close(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        code = next((value for value in args if isinstance(value, int)), None)
        reason = next((value for value in args if isinstance(value, str)), None)
        snapshot = capture_runtime_snapshot()
        _log.warning(
            "Socket Mode close region=%s pid=%s code=%s reason=%s rss_mb=%s maxrss_mb=%s threads=%s fds=%s",
            self.region_key,
            snapshot.pid,
            code if code is not None else "-",
            reason or "-",
            to_megabytes(snapshot.rss_bytes),
            to_megabytes(snapshot.max_rss_bytes),
            snapshot.thread_count,
            snapshot.fd_count,
        )

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._stop_event.set()
        poll_thread = self._poll_thread
        if poll_thread is not None and poll_thread.is_alive():
            poll_thread.join(timeout=1)
        try:
            self.socket_client.disconnect()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception("Socket client disconnect failed; continuing with full close")
        finally:
            self.socket_client.close()


class TriggerRequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server: TriggerHTTPServer

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
        if self.path != "/healthz":
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "Not found"})
            return
        self._send_json(
            HTTPStatus.OK,
            {
                "status": "ok",
                "region": self.server.region_key,
            },
        )

    def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
        if self.path == "/slack/commands":
            self._handle_slack_command()
            return
        if self.path != "/run":
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "Not found"})
            return
        if self.server.trigger_token:
            provided = self.headers.get("X-Trigger-Token")
            if provided != self.server.trigger_token:
                self._send_json(HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, {"error": "Invalid trigger token"})
                return

        try:
            payload = self._read_payload()
            since = _parse_since(payload.get("since"))
        except JSONDecodeError:
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "Invalid JSON body"})
            return
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": str(exc)})
            return

        if not self.server.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": "A run is already in progress"})
            return

        dry_run = bool(payload.get("dry_run", self.server.dry_run_default))
        log_only = bool(payload.get("log_only", self.server.log_only_default))
        newsletter_only = bool(
            payload.get("newsletter_only", self.server.newsletter_only_default)
        )
        skip_backend = bool(payload.get("skip_backend", False))
        try:
            result = self.server.execute_run(
                dry_run=dry_run,
                log_only=log_only,
                newsletter_only=newsletter_only,
                skip_backend=skip_backend,
                since=since,
                source="Trigger request",
                remote=self.client_address[0] if self.client_address else None,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": str(exc)})
            return
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception("Triggered run failed region=%s", self.server.region_key)
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, {"error": str(exc)})
            return
        finally:
            self.server.run_lock.release()
        self._send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {"result": result})

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args) -> None:  # noqa: A003
        return

    def _read_payload(self) -> dict:
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if length == 0:
            return {}
        raw = self.rfile.read(length)
        if not raw:
            return {}
        return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))

    def _send_json(self, status: HTTPStatus, payload: dict) -> None:
        data = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def _handle_slack_command(self) -> None:
        raw_body = self._read_raw_body()
        if not raw_body:
            self._send_json(
                HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                {"response_type": "ephemeral", "text": "Missing slash command payload."},
            )
            return

        region = self.server.app_config.regions[self.server.region_key]
        try:
            signing_secret = region.slack.resolved_signing_secret()
        except ValueError:
            self._send_json(
                HTTPStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                {
                    "response_type": "ephemeral",
                    "text": "Slack signing secret is not configured for this region.",
                },
            )
            return

        if not _verify_slack_signature(
            signing_secret=signing_secret,
            timestamp=self.headers.get("X-Slack-Request-Timestamp"),
            signature=self.headers.get("X-Slack-Signature"),
            body=raw_body,
        ):
            self._send_json(
                HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
                {"response_type": "ephemeral", "text": "Invalid Slack signature."},
            )
            return

        payload = {
            key: values[0]
            for key, values in parse_qs(raw_body.decode("utf-8"), keep_blank_values=True).items()
        }
        if payload.get("ssl_check") == "1":
            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {"ok": True})
            return

        channel_id = str(payload.get("channel_id") or "")
        response_url = str(payload.get("response_url") or "")
        if not _channel_is_connected(region=region, channel_id=channel_id):
            self._send_json(
                HTTPStatus.OK,
                {
                    "response_type": "ephemeral",
                    "text": "This command only works in the connected Slack channels for this region.",
                },
            )
            return

        if not self.server.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            self._send_json(
                HTTPStatus.OK,
                {
                    "response_type": "ephemeral",
                    "text": "A newsletter run is already in progress. Try again in a minute.",
                },
            )
            return

        Thread(
            target=self._run_slack_command,
            args=(response_url, channel_id),
            daemon=True,
            name="slack-command-newsletter",
        ).start()
        self._send_json(
            HTTPStatus.OK,
            {
                "response_type": "ephemeral",
                "text": "Starting newsletter generation. I’ll post the result back here.",
            },
        )

    def _run_slack_command(self, response_url: str, channel_id: str) -> None:
        try:
            result = self.server.execute_run(
                dry_run=False,
                log_only=False,
                newsletter_only=False,
                skip_backend=True,
                rebuild_newsletter_today=True,
                since=None,
                source="Slack command",
                remote=channel_id,
            )
            payload = _build_slack_command_result_payload(
                region_key=self.server.region_key,
                result=result or {},
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception("Slack command failed region=%s channel=%s", self.server.region_key, channel_id)
            payload = {
                "response_type": "ephemeral",
                "text": f"Newsletter generation failed: {exc}",
            }
        finally:
            self.server.run_lock.release()

        if response_url:
            try:
                self.server.slack_response_sender(response_url, payload)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                _log.exception(
                    "Failed to send Slack command response region=%s channel=%s",
                    self.server.region_key,
                    channel_id,
                )

    def _read_raw_body(self) -> bytes:
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if length == 0:
            return b""
        return self.rfile.read(length)


def create_trigger_server(
    *,
    app_config: AppConfig,
    default_region: str | None,
    host: str,
    port: int,
    trigger_token: str | None,
    dry_run_default: bool,
    log_only_default: bool,
    newsletter_only_default: bool = False,
    poll_interval_seconds: int = DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
    runner_factory=None,
    slack_response_sender=None,
) -> TriggerHTTPServer:
    region_key = _resolve_region_key(app_config, default_region)
    narrowed_config = AppConfig(regions={region_key: app_config.regions[region_key]})
    runner = runner_factory(narrowed_config) if runner_factory else build_runner(narrowed_config)
    return TriggerHTTPServer(
        host=host,
        port=port,
        region_key=region_key,
        app_config=narrowed_config,
        runner=runner,
        trigger_token=trigger_token,
        dry_run_default=dry_run_default,
        log_only_default=log_only_default,
        newsletter_only_default=newsletter_only_default,
        poll_interval_seconds=poll_interval_seconds,
        slack_response_sender=slack_response_sender,
    )


def create_socket_mode_server(
    *,
    app_config: AppConfig,
    default_region: str | None,
    dry_run_default: bool,
    log_only_default: bool,
    newsletter_only_default: bool = False,
    poll_interval_seconds: int = DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
    runner_factory=None,
    socket_client_factory=None,
    slack_response_sender=None,
    run_lock: Lock | None = None,
) -> SocketModeCommandServer:
    region_key = _resolve_region_key(app_config, default_region)
    narrowed_config = AppConfig(regions={region_key: app_config.regions[region_key]})
    runner = runner_factory(narrowed_config) if runner_factory else build_runner(narrowed_config)
    region = narrowed_config.regions[region_key]
    socket_client = None
    if socket_client_factory is not None:
        socket_client = socket_client_factory(
            app_token=region.slack.resolved_app_token(),
            bot_token=region.slack.resolved_bot_token(),
        )
    return SocketModeCommandServer(
        region_key=region_key,

class ListenRuntime:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        region_key: str,
        app_config: AppConfig,
        runner,
        dry_run_default: bool,
        log_only_default: bool,
        newsletter_only_default: bool = False,
        poll_interval_seconds: int = DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
        run_lock: Lock | None = None,
        slack_listener=None,
        discord_runtime=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.region_key = region_key
        self.app_config = app_config
        self.runner = runner
        self.dry_run_default = dry_run_default
        self.log_only_default = log_only_default
        self.newsletter_only_default = newsletter_only_default
        self.poll_interval_seconds = max(0, poll_interval_seconds)
        self.run_lock = run_lock or Lock()
        self.slack_listener = slack_listener
        self.discord_runtime = discord_runtime
        self._stop_event = Event()
        self._poll_thread: Thread | None = None

    def execute_run(
        self,
        *,
        dry_run: bool,
        log_only: bool,
        newsletter_only: bool,
        skip_backend: bool = False,
        rebuild_newsletter_today: bool = False,
        since: datetime | None,
        source: str,
        remote: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict | None:
        try:
            validate_runtime_requirements(
                self.app_config,
                region_key=self.region_key,
                dry_run=dry_run,
                log_only=log_only,
                newsletter_only=newsletter_only,
                skip_backend=skip_backend,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            _log.error("%s rejected region=%s error=%s", source, self.region_key, exc)
            raise

        _log.info(
            "%s region=%s dry_run=%s log_only=%s newsletter_only=%s skip_backend=%s since=%s remote=%s",
            source,
            self.region_key,
            dry_run,
            log_only,
            newsletter_only,
            skip_backend,
            since.isoformat() if since else None,
            remote,
        )
        result = self.runner.run(
            region_key=self.region_key,
            dry_run=dry_run,
            log_only=log_only,
            newsletter_only=newsletter_only,
            skip_backend=skip_backend,
            rebuild_newsletter_today=rebuild_newsletter_today,
            since=since,
        )
        _log.info(
            "%s complete region=%s run_id=%s packages=%s beehiiv=%s backend=%s",
            source,
            self.region_key,
            result.get("run_id"),
            result.get("packages"),
            result.get("beehiiv"),
            result.get("backend"),
        )
        return result

    def run_scheduled_poll_once(self) -> dict | None:
        if not self.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            _log.info(
                "Skipping scheduled poll region=%s because another run is in progress",
                self.region_key,
            )
            return None
        try:
            return self.execute_run(
                dry_run=self.dry_run_default,
                log_only=self.log_only_default,
                newsletter_only=self.newsletter_only_default,
                skip_backend=False,
                rebuild_newsletter_today=False,
                since=None,
                source="Scheduled poll",
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            _log.exception("Scheduled poll failed region=%s", self.region_key)
            return None
        finally:
            self.run_lock.release()

    def start_background_polling(self) -> None:
        if self.poll_interval_seconds <= 0 or self._poll_thread is not None:
            return
        self._poll_thread = Thread(target=self._poll_loop, daemon=True, name="region-listen-poller")
        self._poll_thread.start()

    def _poll_loop(self) -> None:
        self.run_scheduled_poll_once()
        while not self._stop_event.wait(self.poll_interval_seconds):
            self.run_scheduled_poll_once()

    def serve_forever(self) -> None:
        if self.slack_listener is not None:
            self.slack_listener.start()
        if self.discord_runtime is not None:
            self.discord_runtime.start()
        self.start_background_polling()
        self._stop_event.wait()

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._stop_event.set()
        poll_thread = self._poll_thread
        if poll_thread is not None and poll_thread.is_alive():
            poll_thread.join(timeout=1)
        if self.slack_listener is not None:
            self.slack_listener.close()
        if self.discord_runtime is not None:
            self.discord_runtime.close()


def create_listen_runtime(
    *,
    app_config: AppConfig,
    default_region: str | None,
    dry_run_default: bool,
    log_only_default: bool,
    newsletter_only_default: bool = False,
    poll_interval_seconds: int = DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
    runner_factory=None,
    socket_server_factory=None,
    discord_runtime_factory=None,
) -> ListenRuntime:
    region_key = _resolve_region_key(app_config, default_region)
    narrowed_config = AppConfig(regions={region_key: app_config.regions[region_key]})
    runner = runner_factory(narrowed_config) if runner_factory else build_runner(narrowed_config)
    region = narrowed_config.regions[region_key]
    shared_run_lock = Lock()

    slack_listener = None
    if region.slack is not None:
        if socket_server_factory is not None:
            slack_listener = socket_server_factory(run_lock=shared_run_lock)
        else:
            slack_listener = create_socket_mode_server(
                app_config=narrowed_config,
                default_region=region_key,
                dry_run_default=dry_run_default,
                log_only_default=log_only_default,
                newsletter_only_default=newsletter_only_default,
                poll_interval_seconds=0,
                runner_factory=lambda _config: runner,
                run_lock=shared_run_lock,
            )

    discord_runtime = None
    if region.discord is not None:
        if discord_runtime_factory is not None:
            discord_runtime = discord_runtime_factory(run_lock=shared_run_lock)
        else:
            discord_runtime = DiscordBotRuntime(
                region_key=region_key,
                discord_config=region.discord,
                runner=runner,
                run_lock=shared_run_lock,
            )

            runner.source_clients.append(DiscordPollingClient(runtime=discord_runtime))

    return ListenRuntime(
        region_key=region_key,
        app_config=narrowed_config,
        runner=runner,
        dry_run_default=dry_run_default,
        log_only_default=log_only_default,
        newsletter_only_default=newsletter_only_default,
        poll_interval_seconds=poll_interval_seconds,
        run_lock=shared_run_lock,
        slack_listener=slack_listener,
        discord_runtime=discord_runtime,
    )


def _channel_is_connected(*, region, channel_id: str) -> bool:
    if not channel_id:
        return False
    connected = set(region.slack.channels)
    if region.slack.output_channel:
        connected.add(region.slack.output_channel)
    return channel_id in connected


def _verify_slack_signature(
    *,
    signing_secret: str,
    timestamp: str | None,
    signature: str | None,
    body: bytes,
) -> bool:
    if not timestamp or not signature:
        return False
    try:
        timestamp_value = int(timestamp)
    except ValueError:
        return False
    if abs(int(time.time()) - timestamp_value) > 300:
        return False
    expected = "v0=" + hmac.new(
        signing_secret.encode("utf-8"),
        f"v0:{timestamp}:".encode() + body,
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature)


def _build_slack_command_result_payload(*, region_key: str, result: dict) -> dict[str, str]:
    region_name = region_key.replace("-", " ").title()
    beehiiv = result.get("beehiiv") or {}
    if beehiiv.get("created") and beehiiv.get("draft_url"):
        action = f" ({beehiiv['action']})" if beehiiv.get("action") else ""
        return {
            "response_type": "in_channel",
            "text": (
                f"Newsletter ready for *{region_name}*. "
                f"<{beehiiv['draft_url']}|Open Google Doc>{action}."
            ),
        }
    if beehiiv.get("created"):
        return {
            "response_type": "in_channel",
            "text": f"Newsletter generated for *{region_name}*.",
        }
    if beehiiv.get("failed"):
        errors = beehiiv.get("errors") or []
        suffix = f" {errors[0].get('error', '')}".rstrip() if errors else ""
        return {
            "response_type": "ephemeral",
            "text": f"Newsletter generation failed for *{region_name}*.{suffix}",
        }
    return {
        "response_type": "ephemeral",
        "text": f"No new newsletter items were available for *{region_name}*.",
    }


def _post_slack_command_response(response_url: str, payload: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    requests.post(response_url, json=payload, timeout=10).raise_for_status()
